AI.tldr: AgentPersonaBench（APB）是一个评估大语言模型在四个交互表面（survey/chat/web/app）上是否能在无提示条件下，将潜在人格特质（persona）忠实转化为可观测行为的基准测试，包含2,460个任务、867个特质，验证通过自动审计与专家审查，最高模型全通过率84.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有的人格驱动评估多聚焦于对话风格或自我报告，无法衡量模型在交互环境中是否能真正按照潜在特质行事；APB旨在通过可观测行为而非自我汇报来衡量"潜在人格忠实度"。
AI.method: 三阶段构建流程：①从百万级人格语料中抽取携带目标特质的完整persona，将目标特质嵌入数百个背景属性中；②在四个交互表面（问卷、对话、网页、桌面应用）上构建日常场景，目标特质从不在提示中显式提及；③通过确定性验证器（选项ID、DOM状态、文件状态等）评估行为忠实度，仅对开放式对话使用LLM裁判；任务须经过五项自动审计与三项人工审查方可入册。
AI.result: 评测20个前沿模型臂（8家供应商）：Gemini-3-8-Flash最高达84.7%全通过率，Opus-5-5为82.9%，GPT-6-Astra为82.1%；chat是多数模型最弱表面；多属性任务显著降低小模型表现（如GPT-6-Luna从74.4%降至45.7%）；四表面一致性低（仅37.9%–64.3%同时通过）；跨模型互补性显著，无单一模型在所有特质上最优。
AI.conclusion: 人格忠实度不能仅从对话表现推断，高通过率的表面常与另一表面失败并存；多属性条件对所有模型家族均构成注意力挑战；不同模型呈现显著的特化差异，实际部署应考虑异构路由和表面专用集成。

title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce \textbf{TrustMed-RL}. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.

AI.tldr: TrustMed-RL 是一个面向长程、证据驱动临床诊断的强化学习框架，基于PubMed罕见病案例和24,000余张人工标注图像面板构建。其8B视觉-语言策略在2,500个评估案例上达到37.1%的诊断准确率，在覆盖≥50%证据的条件下达到32.5%，超过GPT-4o 6.8个百分点，并得到医生评估的高度认可。
AI.motivation: 现有医学语言模型可能在诊断正确但调查不完整或推理缺乏证据支持的情况下得出结论。仅评估最终诊断端点可能掩盖不完整的检查、未经验证的判断以及对不可靠证据的忽视，亟需一种将诊断结果与可观察的临床证据获取过程相关联的方法。
AI.method: 1) 将诊断路径建模为有限时域POMDP，通过状态依赖动作整合问诊、检查、检测、专科会诊和文献检索（21项体检、42项诊断测试、8个专科科室）；2) 基于RareArena扩展多模态长程智能体基准，采用24,000+面板级图像标注和本体论诊断匹配；3) 临床适配的GiGPO（组内组策略优化）结合证据覆盖调整的诊断奖励、本地无效动作惩罚、选择性强化以及ScalingInter-RL交互课程进行长程策略学习；4) 两阶段训练：SFT初始化 + 256轮RL更新（16任务/批次，9回合/任务，共144条轨迹）。
AI.result: TrustMed-RL（GiGPO, 8B）在2,500个干净案例上达到37.1%诊断准确率（领先所有开源权重模型），相比SFT提升12.4个百分点；在Acc@50条件下达到32.5%，超过GPT-4o 6.8个百分点；证据获取覆盖率83.9%，产出性动作8.5次/回合；在MTMedDialog（48.7%/49.5%）和AgentClinic（MedQA 62.2%, NEJM 26.2%）上展现强OOD泛化；医生对200条轨迹的评估中，83.0%获得证据基础评分4-5/5。
AI.conclusion: TrustMed-RL通过将诊断结果与证据获取行为显式耦合，证明了长程强化学习可以同时提升诊断准确性和证据驱动的可信度。其框架、基准和训练协议为迭代自我改进提供了基础，但图像完整性检测在RL后有所下降，8B策略在经验不可解案例上仍存在能力瓶颈。

title: TimeNet: An Extensible Unified Data Infrastructure for Next-Generation Temporal Foundation Models
summary: Temporal Foundation Models (TFMs) aim to generalize across domains, datasets, and tasks. Yet, their development remains constrained by fragmented, task-specific data formats, annotations, and processing pipelines. We introduce TimeNet, an open-source data standard and scalable infrastructure that decouples temporal data from task definitions and represents signals, metadata, annotations, and supervision in a shared, extensible data model. TimeNet supports multimodal signals with regular, irregular, or ordinal time axes and expresses different task families (including classification, forecasting, temporal localization, question answering, generation, and editing) as reusable views over the same recordings. This shared representation enables heterogeneous time-series datasets to be combined for large-scale model training across domains, modalities, and tasks. We demonstrate TimeNet by transcoding datasets with 1.5M task instances spanning diverse domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision, while retaining practical I/O performance relative to native formats. TimeNet enables an existing TFN training pipeline to support joint training on a configurable number of heterogeneous datasets through configuration changes alone. We show this capability by training TFM across multiple datasets and tasks, obtaining a 14% F1 score improvement compared with models trained on individual datasets. These results show that TimeNet provides the data and systems foundation needed to move beyond task- and dataset-specific TFMs toward models that can learn jointly across heterogeneous domains, modalities, temporal scales, and forms of supervision from a common data model.

AI.tldr: TimeNet提出了一套面向时间序列基础模型（TFM）的统一开源数据标准与可扩展基础设施，通过解耦时间数据与任务定义，将多模态信号、元数据、标注与监督统一在同一数据模型中，使异构数据集能跨域、跨模态、跨任务联合训练，同时保持接近原生格式的I/O性能。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列数据集通常以任务专属、自包含的方式发布，格式、标注与加载管线高度碎片化，导致同一原始记录（如PTB-XL的ECG信号）需反复打包成多个任务特定数据集，无法支持跨域、跨模态、跨任务的下一代TFM联合训练需求。
AI.method: 1) 设计统一数据模型TimeF，包含Record→Source→Signal的递归层次、Span寻址机制、可复用Annotation与Task的解耦对象模型；2) 提出基于任务签名ϕ(τ)=(κ,Δ,α)的组合式任务分类法，将任务划分为属性推断、时序定位、未来方向推断、关系推断、时序构造、时序变换六大构建族；3) 采用DuckDB控制平面+Parquet/Zarr值平面的分离存储架构，通过统一API实现N+M集成替代N×M配对集成；4) 基于download→convert→derive_schema→store的连接器管线将异构源数据集标准化并发布为不可变版本化条目。
AI.result: 1) 成功转码6个异构数据集共151万任务实例（89.9万QA、48.4万分类、13.1万生成、441时序定位、292标量预测）；2) 在OpenTSLM上跨Sleep-EDF、ECG-QA、HEARTS、ARFBench四个数据集联合训练使平均F1从29.16提升至33.28（提升14%），所有四个数据集F1均提升；3) I/O基准测试显示TimeNet虽未严格快于原生格式，但吞吐量处于可比范围，且显著减少HTTP请求数和传输负载。
AI.conclusion: TimeNet为时间序列领域提供了从碎片化、单次发布的数据集生态向共享注册库、通用读/写/标注/扩展/版本化机制转变的实践基础；存储一次原始记录、新增标注与任务无需复制或重构源数据，从而支撑跨异构域、模态、时间尺度与监督形式的下一代TFM协同学习。

title: CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of Black-Box Reinforcement Learning Policies
summary: The deployment of Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents in critical domains must be preceded with a pipeline to evaluate the alignment of the RL agent with complex multi-objective specifications and robustness under real-world environmental drift. However, to protect intellectual property, the RL agent may be delivered for evaluation as opaque executable or remote API, which makes traditional evaluation techniques based on the internals of the policies infeasible. To address this gap, CORE-RL: Confidence-Oriented Reliability Evaluation of black box RL policy is proposed in this paper. The CORE-RL pipeline introduces a Unified Reliability Metric that formally integrates early task termination and safety constraint violations, preventing unsafe policies from masking failures through premature episode halts. By subjecting the policy to a noise certification envelope of perceptual noise, actuation noise and change in environment dynamics, the pipeline computes the finite-sample Clopper-Pearson bounds on unified reliability metric and Hoeffdings' lower bound on reward and safety cost. The pipeline then defines safe operational design domain to report high-confidence certificates for safety and expected performance. Experiments on continuous control tasks demonstrate the CORE-RL pipeline's ability to automatically reject non-compliant policies and map the safe Operational Design Domain (ODD) of safety-aware policies. Thus CORE-RL provides an evaluation framework towards a quantitative, transparent and reproducible, statistical rationale necessary to safely evaluate, compare, and deploy black box RL solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CORE-RL框架，用于对黑盒强化学习策略进行统计认证评估，结合统一可靠性指标(URM)和操作设计域(ODD)，通过Clopper-Pearson界和Hoeffding下界提供高置信度的安全性与性能保证。
AI.motivation: 在关键领域部署RL智能体时，由于知识产权保护，第三方策略通常以黑盒API形式提供，传统白盒验证方法不可用。需要一种统计认证框架来评估黑盒RL策略在规格偏差和环境偏差下的可靠性与安全性。
AI.method: 1. 提出统一可靠性指标(URM)：将任务未完成(¬Goal)与安全约束违反(Violation)合并为单一布尔失败条件 F(τ)=I[¬Goal(τ)]∨Violation(τ)；2. 噪声认证包络：定义感知噪声(σ_s)和执行噪声(σ_a)；3. 统计认证协议：使用Clopper-Pearson精确有限样本置信区间估计失败概率上界，使用Hoeffding不等式给出奖励和成本的下界；4. 操作设计域(ODD)：在噪声网格上进行族系可靠的Bonferroni校正认证。
AI.result: 在Safety Gymnasium的三个连续控制任务(SafetyAnt、SafetyCar、SafetyPointGoal)上，使用PPO、TRPO及其Lagrangian变体进行评估，每配置10000回合。在零噪声下TRPO-Lagrangian在SafetyAnt和SafetyPointGoal通过认证(URM CP上界≤0.05)。在L∞对抗噪声下，TRPO-Lagrangian在SafetyAnt获得更宽的认证ODD(多数配置通过)，而PPO-Lagrangian无安全运行域。TRPO-Lagrangian在SafetyCar的延迟扰动下显示意外韧性(Δ=5时通过认证)，但对随机动力学变化鲁棒性有限。附录提供了样本复杂度表(如零失败时N≈45即可认证p*=0.05@90%置信度)。
AI.conclusion: CORE-RL提供了一个统计基础的黑盒RL策略认证管道，能够在无需访问内部参数的情况下自动拒绝不合规策略，并映射出安全感知策略的安全运行设计域。框架通过统一可靠性指标防止不安全策略通过提前终止掩盖失败，为安全关键领域的RL部署提供了定量、透明、可复现的统计依据。未来工作将扩展至多智能体设置和真实部署环境。

title: Asking Earns Nothing: Scoring the Decision to Act in BFCL Multi-Turn
comment: 19 pages, 2 figures. Code and data: this https URL
summary: An agent that lacks the information it needs should ask rather than act, and the task definitions of agent leaderboards say so. BFCL multi-turn builds two of its four categories around a turn on which the model is supposed to ask, and its scorer never looks at that turn: the gold trajectory there is empty, the checker skips it, and the scripted user cannot answer, so asking earns nothing, guessing costs nothing on that turn, and asking twice loses the item. The benchmark also contains the control experiment for that decision. A should-ask item is a base item with one piece of information removed from one turn, so the same request appears twice at the same turn index, once complete and once not: on the first the model should make the call that changes the world, on the second it should ask. We score one decision per pair, whether the model attempted a world-changing call on that turn, read off the stored trajectories with no LLM judge; acting always and asking always both score 50. On the 223 pairs that pose this decision, gpt-5.4 attempts the call on 83.4% of the complete turns and holds back on 78.0% of the incomplete ones, the best decision accuracy of seven models at 80.7%; on the same items the official score ranks it sixth and puts first a model that lands in the middle here. One added line telling gpt-5.4 not to ask pushes it toward acting on both sides of the pair, so its decision accuracy shows no detectable change, while its official score rises by 13.5 to 23.5 points on the two should-ask categories and on the base twins; the opposite line, telling gemma-4-31B-it to ask first, improves its decision by 4.5 points and gains no official score. The score moves with the push toward action, not with the decision. We release the pairs, a turn-level scorer that runs on any BFCL output directory without an API key, and 31 manually verified bad items.

AI.tldr: BFCL多轮评估中两个"应该询问"的类别（miss_func和miss_param）围绕模型理应询问缺失信息的轮次构建，但官方评分器从未对该轮次打分——询问得不到奖励，盲猜也不受惩罚。文章利用基准测试自带的扰动设计构建了223个配对项（双向）（I项），无需任何LLM评判器，判断测量模型在完整侧应行动、在不完整侧应抑制行动的"行动决策"。官方分数不反映该决策；一行提示即可推动模型在不完整轮次上采取行动，同时官方分数上升13.5–23.5分，而决策本身几乎不变。
AI.motivation: BFCL是智能体领域被广泛引用的排行榜之一，但其多轮评分机制存在根本性问题：两个类别（miss_func、miss_param）专门为测试"信息不足时应询问而非行动"而设计，但其评分器跳过该轮次，使得询问既无收益也无损失。作者从一个异常排名现象出发（gpt-5.4在800项上仅获34%排名第四），深入调查评分机制本身的缺陷。
AI.method: 核心方法是利用基准测试自身的扰动结构：should-ask项是base项移除一个信息后形成的，从而形成天然配对。在完整侧（base）模型应做出改变世界的调用，在不完整侧（miss）模型应保持克制。通过读取已存储的轨迹，判断模型是否尝试了改变世界的调用（写文件、下单、发推等；查找不计）。决策准确度 = ½(Pr[行动|信息完整] + Pr[克制|信息缺失])，随机水平恰好为50。还设计了一行提示注入的配对实验：gpt-5.4加"不要询问，直接行动"，gemma-4-31B-it加"先询问再行动"。
AI.result: 在223个配对项上，gpt-5.4决策准确度80.7%排名第一，但官方分数32.7%排名第六；官方第一的Qwen3.6-27B（58.7%）在决策上仅排第五。官方分数与决策的秩相关系数为-0.11。提示注入显示：gpt-5.4加"直接行动"提示后，决策准确度变化在置信区间内（+1.1分），但官方分数在miss_param上升13.5分、miss_func上升16分、base twins上升23.5分；gemma-4-31B-it加"先询问"提示后，决策提升4.5分，但官方分数在三/四类别中下降。分数随推动行动的倾向而变化，不随决策本身变化。
AI.conclusion: BFCL多轮评分存在系统性缺陷：构建于"询问"行为之上的轮次从未被评分；询问不得分，二次询问丢分；官方分数衡量的不是这些类别本应测试的决策，而是其余轮次上的执行能力。基准测试本身的扰动结构提供了被评分的配对，任何构建欠规范变体的排行榜都已拥有该配对。当前评分不奖励澄清也不奖励克制，会引导模型倾向于行动而非求证——这是安全特性问题。建议真正评估交互式智能体的基准应能回答模型提出的问题并对回复与状态都评分。

title: MERCI Cards: An LLM Evaluation and Deployment Framework for High-Stakes Domains
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in high-stakes professional workflows, engineers and researchers require principled protocols to systematically track, monitor, and improve model performance across deployment cycles. We present a mathematical framework for iterative LLM evaluation and deployment, and demonstrate its application to AI systems used in criminal justice. Our framework formalizes LLM integration in high-stakes, high-risk, and resource-constrained domains across model selection, rubric design, evaluations and deployment via a weighted multi-objective optimization. We demonstrate that MERCI Cards can guide improvements of the system across deployment iterations, direct developer attention toward under-performing areas, and focus user attention on validation and error-correction in the LLM's outputs.

AI.tldr: MERCI Cards提出了一种数学化框架,将LLM在高风险、资源受限领域(如刑事司法)的部署形式化为迭代式加权多目标优化流程,通过Model-Evaluation-Rubric-Iterate(模型-评估-评分量规-迭代)卡作为版本化可审计工件,并在加州Racial Justice Act证据报告生成平台Redo.io上进行了实际应用验证。
AI.motivation: LLM正被部署到高风险专业工作流中,但缺乏系统化原则来跟踪、监控和改进模型性能。现有LLM评判存在自偏好偏差和评分上限效应,而人类评估虽具领域专业知识但成本高昂且难以规模化。在刑事司法等资源受限领域,缺乏系统的评估与部署协议使从业者对AI集成持怀疑态度,亟需一个能平衡质量、成本、延迟和人工参与的透明框架。
AI.method: 框架将LLM部署分解为配置(A-D)、评估(E-F)、执行评分(G)、发布决策(H)四阶段迭代循环。核心方法包括:(1)形式化任务𝒯、配置元组(G,P,C,R,W)、评分量规维度集合R、评估者(J评判者与H人类评审者)及其聚合函数agg;(2)以加权多目标优化max Σw_d·Q_d - w_c·c - w_t·t指导模型选择与迭代;(3)通过min-max归一化在候选模型集ℳ上计算复合得分Ŝ_m;(4)设置评判者约束ℱ(J)≠ℱ(G)且ρ(J)≥ρ(G)以减少自偏好偏差;(5)使用Krippendorff α等信度指标和阈值δ_ϕ门控人类评分;(6)设置逐维度发布下限δ_{·,d}而非仅依赖平均分;(7)每轮迭代生成包含choice/derived/record/optional四类字段的MERCI卡作为版本化工件。
AI.result: 在Redo.io的τ=1迭代中,11个候选配置(N=18,ℓ=15)中选定Opus(ρ(G)=3,Ŝ_G=11.94),评判者为GPT(ρ(J)=3)。30份报告评估显示:评判均分0.92(较τ=0提升0.21),人类均分0.88(提升0.10)。9个维度中Cmp(0.74)和Lim(0.75)表现最弱,而OR Smp、RR Smp、χ²Smp等4个维度出现评判方差为零的天花板效应。人类信度Krippendorff α=0.08(3对评审员中有2对为负),被解读为评分量规歧义。该迭代未发布,因未预设逐维度下限。
AI.conclusion: MERCI Cards提供了一个领域无关、形式化的迭代部署框架,核心价值在于:(1)将LLM评判者作为可扩展可复现的评估工具,人类评审者作为补充信号,两者角色分离使专家精力集中于高边际价值维度;(2)权重向量提供可审计机制,将领域优先级显式编码到模型选择决策中;(3)框架稳定支撑新模型迭代测试,无需重新设计评估管线。其局限在于:卡面向技术受众而非终端用户(如律师);记录的是相关性而非因果归因;评分量规需随系统演进持续修订。作者将其定位为持续版本化的活文档,而非固定规范。

title: What Does a Harness Buy? Tokens, Mostly
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures. Code and data: this https URL
summary: A coding agent is a language model wrapped in a harness: the system prompt, the tool set, and the context management that turn a chat model into something that can work inside a repository. Production harnesses ship releases daily, vendors advertise pass-rate gains from harness changes, and leaderboards mix harnesses freely. What is rarely measured is how much the harness itself moves the score when the model is held fixed. We run five models through three production harnesses, Claude Code, mini-SWE-agent, and OpenCode, on SWE-bench Verified, and rerun the same configurations to calibrate how much a score moves when nothing changes but the run. On 447 tasks and the two models we ran there, Claude Code and mini-SWE-agent, the heaviest and the lightest harness, are equivalent within five points. On a 45-task hard subset and five models, swapping the harness flips as many tasks as rerunning the same harness, 13% in both cases, and the tasks a harness wins in one run are not the tasks it wins in the next. The one harness effect that clears the noise is a loss, not a gain: OpenCode trails by up to 9 points on the large pool, and on one model half of that gap sits in runs its output cap cut short. What the harness does decide is the bill. With the same model, the same tasks, and one price list, cost per task differs by up to 3x across harnesses. The gap is set at the first call, by the preamble of system prompt and tool schemas each harness sends with every step, and scaled by the number of steps; per-step growth and per-call tool output differ far less. The provider's price for cached input scales the bill and does not reorder it. The rerun data also give the resolution a harness comparison needs: at the discordance we observe, 45 tasks catch a 13-point gap only half the time and no gap with 80% power, and 447 tasks resolve 5 points, still coarser than the gains many harness changes claim.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在固定模型条件下，编码智能体的"harness"（系统提示、工具集、上下文管理等围绕模型的框架）对 SWE-bench Verified 评测得分的影响。通过控制变量实验发现，harness 对通过率的提升作用微弱（与重跑噪声相当），但对花费的影响显著（最高达3倍差异），且唯一的可检测 harness 效应是失败模式而非得分增益。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍认为 harness 工程对编码智能体的得分有显著影响（甚至有研究声称 harness 差异可达 27.4 分），但这些结论大多基于单次运行、未控制重跑噪声，且不同 harness 的对比常不在公平条件下进行。论文旨在通过严格控制模型变量并加入重跑基线，量化 harness 本身对评测得分和成本的真实影响。
AI.method: 1) 实验对象：3个生产级 harness（Claude Code、mini-SWE-agent、OpenCode）× 5-6个模型（Qwen3.6/3.8、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.3-Flash、HY4-Preview、Claude Opus 5），在 SWE-bench Verified 的 447 任务池和 45 困难子集上评测；2) 关键设计：每个配置进行重跑（部分两次），将 harness 差异与重跑噪声放在同一尺度比较；3) 统计方法：McNemar 精确检验配对差异、Newcombe 置信区间、TOST 等价性检验（δ=5分），并基于观测到的不一致率计算统计检验力；4) 成本分析：按各家供应商列表价将 token 分为缓存命中/未命中/输出三类计费；5) 离线强制：在网络层禁止访问 GitHub 修复补丁，消除数据泄露；6) 附加实验：关闭思考模式、工具消融、旧版本 harness、Terminal-Bench 2.1 迁移检验。
AI.result: 1) 通过率：最重（Claude Code）与最轻（mini-SWE-Agent）的 harness 在两个模型上的447任务池上等价于5分以内（Δ=-1.8 和 -1.4 分）；45困难子集上三 harness 差异为2-5任务，重跑噪声也达3任务，harness 交换与重跑翻转任务的比率均为13%，且赢的任务集在两次运行间不可复现；2) 唯一清晰可辨的 harness 效应：OpenCode 在大池上落后 8-9 分（一半源于输出 token 上限截断无恢复机制）；3) 成本：同一模型同一任务下，每任务花费差异最高达3倍，差异主要来自每个 harness 首次调用携带的预置系统提示+工具架构大小（Claude Code 16.5k、OpenCode 7k、mini-SWE-agent <1k tokens）及步数，per-call 工具返回差异很小；4) 分辨力：在观测到的 discordance 下，45任务仅能以一半概率检出13分差距且无80%检验力，447任务可分辨约5分差距。
AI.conclusion: 在该证据下，harness 带来的是更少的失败方式和账单成本，而非通过率提升。可测量的 harness 效应都是让模型丢失本来能解的任务（输出截断无恢复、无上下文管理、离线搜索工具不可用），未发现 harness 能让模型赢得任务的证据。论文指出当前许多发表的 harness 增益声称低于其统计分辨力，呼吁在 harness 对比中加入同配置重跑作为基线。

title: CRAFT: An Agentic Spreadsheet Form Filling System with Template Awareness
summary: Spreadsheet form filling requires agents to consolidate external evidence, ground values to precise cells, and preserve irregular template structure. Errors in early edits can overwrite labels or misalign fields, undermining later decisions. We propose CRAFT, a template-aware agent framework that connects reflective validation to constrained local repair. Instead of treating reflection as a free-form request to regenerate the workbook, CRAFT grounds detected errors to spreadsheet regions, restores corrupted template state when necessary, and re-grounds plausible writable slots before subsequent edits. A Rectangle-Aware Slot Grounder (RASG) proposes writable cells, while label-slot hints and protected regions constrain subsequent edits. We introduce FormFillBench, with 327 forms across Instruction-Only and Multi-File tracks. Compared with the strongest baselines, CRAFT improves pair accuracy by 8.51 and 23.38 percentage points on these tracks, respectively. Component-removal experiments support structural adjudication and slot re-grounding within the pipeline, and the framework retains its relative advantage among the methods evaluated with a second backbone. The code and benchmark FormFillBench are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CRAFT是一个面向电子表格表单填写的智能体框架，通过模板感知将反射验证与受约束的局部修复相结合。它提出了RASG（矩形感知槽位定位器）用于精确定位可写单元格，并构建了包含327个实例的FormFillBench基准测试。
AI.motivation: 电子表格表单填写不仅要求提取正确信息，还必须将值准确映射到正确单元格并保留不规则模板结构。现有系统对布局变化敏感，错误可能覆写标签或错位字段，且现有基准缺乏对电子表格表单填写的专门评估。
AI.method: CRAFT采用三模块架构：(1)表单填充预处理——构建双视图（可执行视图与布局对齐视觉视图）表示和源文件结构化证据；(2)反射式区域裁决——结合布局全局筛选和结构感知局部裁决（SALA），识别可疑与可靠单元格并构建可疑区域；(3)渐进式槽位重新接地与修复——模板恢复、RASG（基于SegFormer-B1的三头分割网络）定位可写槽位、标签-值匹配、受约束的局部重填。
AI.result: 在FormFillBench上，CRAFT在Instruction-Only和Multi-File两个赛道上的配对准确率分别达到59.68%和66.52%，比最强基线分别提升8.51和23.38个百分点。组件移除实验验证了SALA和渐进式槽位重新接地的互补价值。使用GPT-5.4 mini作为第二骨干仍保持领先优势。在混合槽位布局和重复区域表单类型上优势尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT通过将反射诊断与模板恢复和槽位重新接地耦合，有效解决了电子表格表单填写中的模板保护与空间接地问题。实验验证了结构感知裁决和槽位重新接地作为流水线的互补组件的重要性。框架在保持规则布局竞争力的同时，在结构不规则表单上获得显著优势。未来工作包括扩大评估规模和量化运行间变异性。

title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
summary: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new this http URL template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact constraints before calibrated 2D- to-3D conversion. In real-world trials, RAGrasp achieves 20/20 successful grasps on seen objects and 19/20 on unseen objects. Within the evaluated setting, the results demonstrate deployment- specific grasp adaptation from limited local annotation and tolerance to the tested viewpoint and illumination changes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAGrasp，一种基于检索增强的平面平行夹爪抓取方法，通过小型本地RGB-D模板库实现无需端到端重训练的目标抓取。
AI.motivation: 机器人抓取系统在部署时面临传感器噪声、机器人本体、夹爪几何和工作空间配置与训练数据不匹配的领域鸿沟问题；为每个新部署收集大规模本地数据并重训练预测器成本高昂，因此需要仅从少量本地标注样例实现精确抓取的方法。
AI.method: 五阶段流水线：(1) 使用DINOv2特征结合颜色对比度和深度残差提示SAM2生成质量门控语义掩码；(2) 两阶段几何-语义检索级联，先用轮廓ICP初筛Top-K，再用掩码DINOv2相似度精排；(3) 置信度门控的双路径抓取传输（语义对应+RANSAC vs 轮廓对齐）；(4) 掩码约束的局部优化（mask支持+对极点质量+先验正则化）；(5) 基于深度反投影和手眼标定的2D到3D转换；并支持成功执行后写入模板库。
AI.result: 真实实验中，已见物体20/20（100%），未见物体19/20（95%）；在视角和光照变化下保持较高鲁棒性（俯视和弱光45°倾斜下均为90%）；优于GraspSAM、NDF和AnyGrasp等基线；模板库规模在30-40时性能趋于饱和；消融实验验证了语义掩码、置信门控和局部优化等组件的必要性。
AI.conclusion: RAGrasp通过从紧凑本地模板库检索和传输成功抓取，避免了在大型公共数据集上训练任务特定预测器的需求；适用于模板库包含几何相关实例的场景，但性能依赖于模板覆盖范围、掩码质量和相机-机器人标定精度。

title: Causally Fair Generation with Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate, complete, and transform information in settings where their outputs can shape consequential decisions, raising concerns about their impact on demographic disparities. In this context, causal inference provides a principled basis for assessing fairness, because it attributes observed disparities to the mechanisms that generated them, which a purely statistical approach cannot do even with infinite data. In LLM generation, a query may request several causally related variables, each of which is both an outcome of interest and a possible cause of other outputs, and the information supplied in the prompt need not follow a topological or a temporal order. This calls for methods that can analyze and selectively remove disparities from such a flexible generation process. In this paper we introduce Causally Fair Generation with LLMs (CFG, for short). CFG extracts relevant concepts, grounds generation in a reference population and causal diagram, and removes user-selected causal effects. CFG also allows pathways deemed justifiable for the task's utility to be retained, which is known in legal literature as business necessity. Further, we provide formal guarantees for our method when eliminating all discriminatory causal effects in the adapted population model, under appropriate causal assumptions. We evaluate CFG with four LLMs in three real-world settings based on population data and on a synthetic dataset with a known causal ground truth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CFG（Causally Fair Generation with LLMs），一种基于因果推断的大语言模型公平生成方法。该方法扩展了因果公平性框架至生成式场景，能够针对拓扑和非拓扑查询选择性移除用户指定的因果效应，同时保留"商业必要性"（business necessity）的合法路径。在四个LLM和四个数据集上验证了其效果恢复和偏见移除能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的输出可能影响教育、医疗、招聘等重要决策，但其生成内容可能复制或引入人口统计群体间的差异。现有方法主要基于统计比较，无法解释差异产生的因果路径，也无法选择性保留合法路径（如法律意义上的"商业必要性"）。因此需要一种能够基于因果图进行选择性去偏置的生成框架。
AI.method: CFG是一个推理时的方法框架，包含五个步骤：(1) 查询分析——提取相关概念；(2) 人口基础（Population grounding）——基于真实人口数据估计条件分布；(3) 因果图获取——通过LLM代理或预存模型获取标准公平模型；(4) 交互式去偏——使用fairadapt方法按因果顺序调整属性，支持用户对每个目标变量指定DE、IE、SE移除策略；(5) 提示构建——将采样值插入提示并生成文本。该方法利用选择器指标将LLM分布嵌入到与真实世界SCM兼容的统一结构中，支持拓扑和非拓扑查询（即生成顺序与因果顺序不一致的查询），并通过"商业必要性"集合允许保留特定合法路径。理论保证方面，论文证明了在递归替换策略下，去偏后生成的分布满足条件独立性。
AI.result:
在四个LLM（Qwen3-4B、Llama 3-8B、Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma 4-31B）和四个数据集（NSDUH、BRFSS、ACS以及具有已知因果真值的合成数据集Census-Synth）上的实验表明：(1) 效应恢复方面，CFG在拓扑查询下TV平均误差为0.40-0.66个百分点，显著低于基线（Vanilla、CoT、RAG）；(2) 偏见移除方面，移除所有效应后拓扑中间和最终结果的TV平均绝对值分别从8.65降至0.64、从6.56降至0.54个百分点；(3) 商业必要性方面，保留教育中介路径后，间接效应仍接近真实值（7.26 vs 6.96），体现了BN例外机制的有效性；(4) 非拓扑查询同样可有效去偏且对LLM架构不可知。 |

AI.conclusion: CFG是首个针对因果公平生成的LLM方法，能够处理多个因果相关属性、支持非拓扑查询，并允许通过商业必要性机制选择性保留合法路径。该方法对黑盒LLM有效，在多个真实世界数据集上验证了因果效应恢复和选择性移除的能力。未来工作需要解决人口数据限制、因果图不确定性以及背景协变量单独调整等问题。

title: Understanding Generative AI Use in Programming MOOCs: The Role of Course Context and Learner Characteristics
summary: The increasing availability of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools, such as ChatGPT and code-completion assistants, raises questions about how learners integrate these tools into learning activities, particularly in MOOCs that attract diverse participant populations. This study examines the use of GenAI in two programming MOOCs taught in Estonian that differ in duration, workload, topic complexity, and assignment volume: About Programming (4 weeks, 26 expected hours, n = 187) and Introduction to Programming (8 weeks, 78 expected hours, n = 182). Post-course questionnaire data were analyzed using non-parametric statistical methods to examine self-reported adoption, usage frequency, and purposes of GenAI use across courses and learner backgrounds. The results show that GenAI adoption was widespread in both MOOCs, with no statistically significant differences by gender, age, education level, or prior programming experience. However, participants in the longer, more extensive MOOC reported significantly higher usage frequency and were more likely to use GenAI for debugging and idea generation. Reported usage frequency for code explanation and debugging was also higher in the longer course. Exploratory analyses found limited relationships between GenAI use and learning-related outcomes. The findings suggest that course context may play a greater role than learner characteristics in shaping how GenAI tools are used. These results provide implications for instructional design and guidance in programming education.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了生成式人工智能(GenAI)工具在两门爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC课程中的使用情况，发现课程背景比学习者特征对GenAI使用方式的影响更大。
AI.motivation: 随着ChatGPT等生成式AI工具的普及，理解学习者如何在MOOC中整合这些工具进行学习变得日益重要，特别是在编程教育领域。现有研究缺乏对不同MOOC课程背景下GenAI使用差异的系统比较。
AI.method: 对两门时长、工作量和复杂度不同的爱沙尼亚语编程MOOC（"About Programming" 4周课程n=187和"Introduction to Programming" 8周课程n=182）进行后课程问卷调查，采用非参数统计方法分析自我报告的采用率、使用频率和用途，并按学习者背景（性别、年龄、教育水平、编程经验）进行比较。
AI.result: 两门课程中GenAI采用率均较高，在性别、年龄、教育水平和先前编程经验方面无统计学显著差异。但较长课程（8周）的参与者报告使用频率显著更高，更可能将GenAI用于调试和创意生成。代码解释和调试的使用频率在较长课程中也更高。探索性分析发现GenAI使用与学习相关结果的关系有限。
AI.conclusion: 课程背景在塑造GenAI工具使用方式方面的作用可能大于学习者特征。这些发现对编程教育的教学设计和指导具有启示意义。

title: Trinity: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models with a Self-Verifier
comment: NeurIPS'26 Workshop on Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS)
summary: Self-evolving vision-language models (VLMs), a form of self-improvement in which a model generates its own training data from unlabeled images, are a promising route toward agents that expand their reasoning capability in an unsupervised manner, without relying on ever-larger annotation budgets. Existing methods pair a Questioner that proposes problems with a Solver that answers them, but reward both roles mainly by agreement among sampled answers. Agreement is a weak proxy for truth: it cannot tell whether a question is grounded in the image, whether the proposed reference answer is right, or whether a confident majority is wrong in the same way. We present Trinity, in which one VLM plays three roles, Questioner, Solver, and Verifier, and the Verifier is a self-verifier: an exponential moving average (EMA) of the policy itself, requiring neither labels nor an external judge. The Verifier screens every generated question for image grounding and answer correctness before it becomes supervision, scores Solver reasoning against the image, and adjudicates disputes between the reference answer and a strong Solver consensus, correcting the reference and penalizing the Questioner when the consensus is right. Trained on images alone, Trinity improves Qwen3-VL-8B on mathematical visual reasoning and on science benchmarks with biology content, for example, +8.6 points on the biology split of SciVQR and +12.8 on MathVerse, and its reward dynamics behave as a healthy self-play curriculum should. These results suggest that a self-evolving multimodal agent can strengthen its scientific reasoning from unlabeled scientific images alone, with the model itself serving as the verifier.

AI.tldr: Trinity是一个单模型三角色（Questioner、Solver、Verifier）的视觉-语言模型自进化框架，其中Verifier是策略本身的指数移动平均（EMA）副本。它无需标签或外部评判器，通过Verifier对生成的问题进行图像扎根性和答案正确性筛选，对Solver推理进行评分，并裁决Solver共识与参考答案之间的分歧。仅使用无标签图像训练，Trinity在数学视觉推理和含生物学内容的科学基准上提升Qwen3-VL-8B的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化VLM方法主要依赖Solver采样答案之间的一致性（agreement）作为奖励信号，但这是真理的弱代理：它无法判断问题是否扎根于图像、参考答案是否正确、置信多数是否同样错误。需要引入一个不依赖标签和外部评判器的图像级评估器来解决这些问题。
AI.method: Trinity让单个VLM扮演三个角色：可训练策略π_θ同时作为Questioner和Solver（仅通过提示区分），Verifier π_ϕ是π_θ的EMA副本（α=0.999），不接收梯度且推理时使用。Verifier在三个环节介入：(1) 筛选每个生成的QA对，检查问题扎根性R_fact-q、答案正确性R_corr-a和难度R_diff（四级评分0.1/0.4/0.7/1.0）；(2) 对Solver推理轨迹进行评分R_reason（评分视觉准确性、逻辑、跳跃）；(3) 当75%的Solver答案形成多数与a*矛盾时，重新求解并裁决。Questioner奖励R_Q由格式门、扎根性、经验折扣难度R̃_diff和_solver挑战率R_chal组合；使用GRPO的组相对优势，结合GSPO的序列级clipped surrogate。Verifier通过Polyak平均定期刷新。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B上，仅使用Vero-600K图像训练：MathVerse +12.8、MMMU +12.6、SciVQR-Bio +8.6、EMVista +2.3、MME-SCI +1.3，所有基准均优于基座模型；在OmniScience上训练也得到类似结果。Qwen2.5-VL-7B上Trinity同样改善所有基准，且是唯一未在MathVerse/MathVista上下降的方法。训练动力学显示：问题扎根性R_fact从0.27升至0.57，Solver正确性从0.53升至0.63，推理质量从0.76升至0.93——表明形成了"刚好领先于Solver"的健康课程。
AI.conclusion: Trinity证明了一个自进化多模态智能体可以从无标签科学图像中强化科学推理能力，且模型本身可作为验证器。其贡献是：(1) 三角色单模型自进化框架，使用EMA自验证器无需批评器、工具或标签；(2) 验证器门控奖励，分离真正难度与无效问题；(3) 在数学视觉推理和含生物学内容的科学基准上获得提升。限制包括：验证器可靠性受限于骨干网络本身；三角色同驻导致内存开销大；当前仅支持单图训练；评估仅衡量科学推理组件而非生物发现本身。

title: Reactivating Alignment: Defending LLMs from Jailbreaks via Intention-Aware Input-Output Matching
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that conceal harmful intent within complex adversarial prompts. Existing defenses primarily rely on input perturbation or harmful-output suppression, but they rarely model where malicious intent resides, resulting in brittle protection and excessive over-refusal. We propose SENTINEL, a plug-and-play, generation-time jailbreak defense that reframes mitigation as an intent extraction problem. Our key insight is that instruction-tuned LLMs exhibit strong input--output semantic consistency: regardless of jailbreak complexity, generated outputs tend to align with the attacker's true intent. SENTINEL exploits this property by matching semantically aligned input--output regions to extract intention-revealing subsequences, scores these subsequences using refusal-direction projections to estimate harmfulness, and halts generation when necessary. Experiments on HarmBench across multiple LLMs show that SENTINEL reduces jailbreak success rates to close to 5\% while maintaining low over-refusal. We further demonstrate robustness to adaptive attacks and provide a mechanistic interpretation: SENTINEL re-distributes jailbreak features from alignment blind spots to aligned regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SENTINEL，一种即插即用的生成时越狱防御框架，将防御重构为意图提取问题。该方法利用指令微调LLM的输入-输出语义一致性，通过上下文窗口语义对齐匹配提取意图相关子序列，利用拒绝方向投影进行有害性评分，必要时中断生成。实验表明SENTINEL可将越狱成功率降至约5%，同时保持较低的过度拒答率，并具有对自适应攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM越狱防御方法（输入扰动和有害输出抑制）存在两个主要缺陷：一是基于token级扰动的防御难以应对长且复杂的提示；二是上下文级防御易受指令覆盖攻击。这些方法缺乏对恶意意图的显式建模，导致防御脆弱且过度拒绝严重。核心研究问题是能否显式提取嵌入在复杂提示中的有害意图，从而实现原则化且高效的防御机制。
AI.method: SENTINEL方法包含三个阶段：(1) 通过上下文窗口语义对齐为输入-输出对的token分配重要性分数，利用约束优化问题（最小化跨集Wasserstein距离上界，最大化集内方差正则项）求解；(2) 基于重要性分数通过多阈值过滤生成多个意图相关子序列，再用多样性去重（DiverseTopK）保留少量互不相似的候选；(3) 利用预计算的拒绝方向（refusal direction）对子序列进行有害性投影评分，集成后与阈值比较判定是否终止生成。算法嵌入自回归生成过程中，每生成N个token检查一次，无需微调模型参数。
AI.result: 在HarmBench基准上对Llama2-7B、Llama3-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.2、Vicuna-7B四个LLM的实验显示：SENTINEL将ASR降至接近5%（Llama3-8B约3%，Mistral弱对齐模型也低于5%），且在OR-Bench边界数据集上的过度拒绝率低于同类防御方法。对GCG、PAIR、GPT-Fuzz、FewShot、AutoDAN、RADICAL、DSA等多种攻击均有效。白盒自适应攻击实验表明SENTINEL具有鲁棒性：仅满足合规开头会偏离主题，而保持主题性则会暴露真实意图。意图提取精度（IPS）与防御性能正相关。泛化能力测试（ARC-C、TruthfulQA、GSM8K）显示仅有轻微性能下降，运行时间开销<10%。
AI.conclusion: SENTINEL通过显式意图提取重新激活LLM安全对齐，利用输入-输出语义一致性将防御形式化为正则化匹配问题，在保持较低过度拒绝率的同时实现强防御效果。其工作机制可解释为特征重分布——将越狱输入从对齐盲区重新分布到对齐区域，使得拒绝方向投影能有效区分恶意与正常请求。该方法无需微调，作为即插即用模块可集成到自回归生成中，并对自适应攻击具有鲁棒性。局限在于主要在token空间操作，未来工作可在表示空间中直接定义意图匹配以获得更深入的机制洞见。

title: Semantic Causal-Factor Inference from Aviation Incident Narratives Using A Variational Autoencoder with Cosine-Similarity-Based Reconstruction
summary: Aviation accident and incident investigations generate extensive unstructured textual information containing evidence relevant to the causes and contributing factors of safety occurrences. Automatically extracting such information is challenging because causal evidence may be distributed across long and complex investigation narratives. This study proposes a semantic causal-factor inference framework combining natural language processing with a variational autoencoder (VAE) to learn the relationship between aviation investigation narratives and expert-reported probable causes. Investigation narratives and their corresponding probable causes are transformed into numerical representations, after which the encoder maps narrative representations to a probabilistic latent space. The decoder estimates representations of the corresponding probable causes and is trained using an objective that combines Kullback-Leibler divergence with cosine-similarity-based semantic reconstruction. The framework was evaluated using 20,919 finalized U.S. National Transportation Safety Board investigation reports from 2005 to 2020. On the held-out test set, the predicted and expert-reported probable-cause representations achieved a mean cosine similarity of 0.786 (SD = 0.120). The predicted representations also yielded interpretable terms associated with causal information in the reports. The results demonstrate the potential of probabilistic latent representation learning for AI-assisted extraction of causal information from aviation safety narratives while retaining expert investigation as the basis for formal causal determination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于变分自编码器（VAE）的语义因果因素推断方法，将长篇航空事故调查报告叙述映射到专家报告的可能原因语义表示。在20,919份NTSB最终调查报告（2005–2020年）上测试集平均余弦相似度达到0.786 (SD=0.120)。
AI.motivation: 航空事故调查产生大量非结构化文本，因果证据分散在复杂的叙述中。传统方法将其视为预定义标签的分类任务，无法捕捉跨长文本分布的因果信息。本文旨在将因果因素推断重构为连续语义表示空间中的表征学习问题，避免预设类别限制。
AI.method: 使用spaCy/NLTK进行文本预处理（分词、去停用词、词干化提取），采用预训练GloVe词嵌入+最小最大归一化将叙述和可能原因转为数值向量。编码器为1D卷积结构，将(1200,1)的叙述映射到20维潜在分布；解码器为转置卷积，从潜在向量重建(200,1)的可能原因表示。训练目标结合KL散度（正则化潜空间）+余弦相似度语义重建损失（α=1000）。推理后将预测的数值表示反映射回文本，提取指示性因果术语。最终配置：Adam优化器、学习率0.001、batch size=16、潜在维度=20。
AI.result: 测试集（15%保留）平均余弦相似度0.786 (SD=0.120)。定性分析显示能提取出与着陆齿轮、机械部件、飞行动力学等相关的可解释术语；详细案例中正确恢复了"gear, locked, system, unable, deploy, checklist"等与起落架故障相关的术语。但存在表现较差的低相似度样本，未做系统错误归因。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了概率潜变量表征学习从航空安全叙述中提取因果信息的潜力，但应视为专家定位的辅助工具而非替代正式事故调查。未来需探索上下文语言表示（如Transformer）、系统性错误分析、对比基线模型以及时间/外部验证。

title: InferOpt: Constrained Multi-Objective Search for LLM Inference Configurations
summary: Serving an LLM means setting dozens of inference-time knobs, from per-layer KV retention to per-layer expert counts. Practice sets them with mechanism-specific heuristics that return a single operating point and do not scale to layer-wise search spaces. We recast inference configuration as constrained multi-objective black-box optimization and build InferOpt, a reusable search framework that requires only variable bounds, a deterministic resource cost, and an evaluation hook. InferOpt searches on a frozen sampled proxy set, rejects over-budget candidates before any model call, tightens the budget adaptively, and re-validates Pareto representatives on full-scale dataset. One pipeline covers a 28-dimensional continuous KV space (Qwen2.5-7B) and a 26-dimensional discrete MoE space (DeepSeek-V2-Lite). On KV, post-prefill pruning cuts the 16K cache by 64.4% and TPOT by 22.9--48.5%, and the searched layer-wise budget by InferOpt beats a matched uniform budget by 7.3% and 14.0% of the Full KV reference points. On MoE, a searched top-k schedule by InferOpt removes 43.0% of routed token--expert pairs while staying within 0.59 points of the default, closer than the matched-budget baselines. Against Random Search, NSGA-II, and MOTPE, InferOpt leads on both spaces, taking the best proxy hypervolume and the lowest retention on KV and staying closest to the uncompressed reference at the lowest experts on MoE.

AI.tldr: InferOpt将LLM推理配置建模为约束多目标黑盒优化问题，提出统一搜索框架，在KV缓存压缩和MoE路由两个高维空间中均优于随机搜索、NSGA-II和MOTPE基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理配置依赖机制特定的启发式方法，无法扩展到数十个逐层变量空间，且只能返回单一操作点而非质量-效率Pareto前沿。需要一个统一的优化层来替代这些启发式。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) 代理采样构建冻结的分层子集；(2) 预算感知多目标搜索（TPE），在评估前通过闭式资源成本函数拒绝超预算候选，自适应收紧预算；(3) Pareto最优选择在保留数据上重新验证。在KV缓存（28维连续）和MoE路由（26维离散）两个空间实例化。
AI.result: KV缓存：64.4%缓存削减，TPOT降低22.9-48.5%，搜索分配比均匀分配提升7.3%和14.0%。MoE：减少43.0%路由对，质量仅下降0.59分。在24次试验预算下，InferOpt在两个空间上均优于Random Search、NSGA-II和MOTPE。
AI.conclusion: 共享的预算感知搜索框架可有效替代机制特定的调优启发式，统一支持连续KV保留和离散MoE路由空间，无需为每种机制重新设计。

title: VCLMU: Mechanism-Centric Virtual Cell World Modeling for Perturbation Response
comment: This paper was accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 workshop on AI for drug discovery
summary: Predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations is a central capability for virtual cells and a key step toward computational modeling of biological interventions. Most existing models directly map an unperturbed molecular profile and perturba- tion to the resulting observation without explicitly representing the latent cellular transition induced by the intervention. We introduce a mechanism-centric virtual cell world model that represents cellular state as a set of Latent Mechanism Units (LMUs) and treats genetic perturbations as actions on these latent states. Each LMU combines a reusable identity grounded in multimodal biological evidence with an observation-specific state, allowing a perturbation to induce mechanism- specific stochastic transitions before decoding the resulting transcriptional response. We train VCLMU through two-stage pretraining, first on around 200K pseudo-bulk perturbation profiles and then on gene-aligned single-cell perturbation data. Across six perturbation-disjoint benchmarks, VCLMU consistently improves perturbation- specific response recovery over strong baselines while maintaining competitive global response accuracy. We further analyze learned LMUs through enrichment between perturbation responses and LMU gene sets and show that they capture structured biological response programs. These results support mechanism-level latent state transition as a useful formulation for virtual cell models that aim to predict and interpret cellular responses to biological interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VCLMU，一种面向扰动响应的机制中心虚拟细胞世界模型。它将细胞状态表示为一组潜在机制单元（LMU），将基因扰动视为作用于这些潜在状态的动作，并通过两阶段预训练（伪实体质+基因对齐的单细胞数据）在六个扰动互不相交基准上取得了优于强基线的扰动特异性响应恢复能力，同时LMU学习到了结构化且生物学意义连贯的响应程序。
AI.motivation: 现有扰动预测模型大多直接从未扰动分子剖面映射到扰动后的观测值，没有显式建模干预诱导的潜在细胞状态转变。近期系统评估表明，深度模型甚至难以超越简单的线性或与条件无关的基线，说明建模干预引发的状态变化可能比单纯增加模型容量更为重要。因此，亟需一种机制层面的潜在状态转移框架，以更好地预测和解释细胞对生物干预的响应。
AI.method: 1) **机制中心世界建模**：将细胞状态编码为一组稀疏激活的LMU，每单元包含可复用身份（由多模态生物证据锚定）和观测特定状态。2) **扰动作为动作**：扰动被编码为动作嵌入，独立施加于各单元，使同一扰动可引发异质响应。3) **残差随机转移**：每个活跃LMU从控制状态出发生成动作条件的高斯隐变量，通过FiLM和加性残差更新实现状态转移。4) **转移目标监督**：观察到的扰动剖面通过同一组LMU编码得到目标状态变化，用stop-gradient对齐预测变化，避免目标坍缩。5) **学习目标**：前向重构负对数似然 + 动力学对齐 + KL正则 + 观测重建 + 逆扰动预测 + 多样性/锚定/活性正则。6) **两阶段预训练**：先在约20万伪实体质扰动剖面上预训练，再在基因对齐的单细胞数据上继续预训练，下游微调在六个扰动互不相交基准上进行。
AI.result: 在Adamson、Norman、Replogle K562/RPE1、Tian CRISPRa/CRISPRi六个扰动互不相交基准上，VCLMU-FT在所有数据集上均取得了最佳的Jaccard@20，在Replogle和Tian等基线表现较弱的数据集上提升最大；同时在ΔPCC/ΔPCC@20平面上保持全局响应精度。Stage 2预训练在五个数据集上优于Stage 1。LMU可解释性分析显示：在1101个保留扰动中，86.6%与至少一个LMU显著关联（BH-FDR<0.05），56个不同的LMU作为最佳匹配出现，最频繁的仅占20.9%，中位最佳LMU重叠为7个基因（19.9倍富集），中位候选基因集Jaccard仅0.0079。代表性关联覆盖干扰素反应、有丝分裂调控、T细胞信号传导与激活、氧化磷酸化和RNA加工等生物学连贯程序。
AI.conclusion: VCLMU支持将机制层面潜在状态转移作为虚拟细胞模型的有用且可解释的建模框架，能够在保持全局预测精度的前提下提升响应基因恢复能力，并学习到结构化、生物学连贯的响应程序。当前研究主要聚焦单基因转录组扰动，未来工作将扩展LMU到多模态和组合扰动场景。

title: ManifoldCache: Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration via Constraint Manifold Caching
summary: Diffusion models for structured scientific generation must produce samples satisfying hard geometric constraints imposed by physics, chemistry, or biology, yet inference in these settings is prohibitively slow, demanding hundreds to thousands of neural-function evaluations per sample. We unify eight state-of-the-art models spanning medical volumetrics, molecular conformations, protein backbone design, crystal structure prediction, and multi-view 3D scenes under a single abstraction, Constraint-Manifold Diffusion Models (CMDMs), in which the target distribution is supported on a manifold defined by an externally specified constraint map. All existing acceleration families fail on this class: quantization exhausts memory on high-dimensional volumetric operators; pruning breaks constraint fidelity; fast ODE solvers allow trajectories to drift off the constraint manifold; and feature-caching heuristics are blind to constraint geometry, inducing mode confusion in the high-noise regime. We introduce ManifoldCache, the first training-free, data-free accelerator designed from first principles for CMDMs. The key insight is that the conditional score decomposes orthogonally into a normal component, which enforces constraint satisfaction, and a tangential component, which navigates within the manifold. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the noise-schedule midpoint is a sharp safe-caching boundary: caching before it incurs provably bounded error, while caching after it guarantees a strictly positive fraction of trajectories suffer mode confusion, a gap that persists up to the boundary. We further prove that deeper network blocks admit provably larger certified cache strides within the safe phase, as a consequence of the score decomposition propagating through block Jacobians. The resulting schedule requires no calibration data, along with zero training overhead.

AI.tldr: ManifoldCache 提出了一种无需训练、无需校准的特征缓存加速框架，专为约束流形扩散模型（CMDM）设计。它利用条件分数的正交分解（法向分量负责约束满足，切向分量负责流形内导航），推导出基于噪声调度的安全缓存阈值 T*，并通过深度自适应缓存策略在八个科学领域 CMOM 上实现 1.2–1.9× 加速且质量损失最小。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在科学生成（医学影像、分子构象、蛋白质骨架、晶体结构、多视角 3D 场景）中面临硬几何约束，需要数百至数千次神经网络函数评估，推理极慢。现有加速方法（量化、剪枝、快速 ODE 求解器、特征缓存）均存在缺陷：量化在高维体积算子上耗尽显存；剪枝破坏约束保真度；快速求解器使轨迹偏离约束流形；特征缓存启发式方法对约束几何不敏感，在高噪声阶段引起模式混淆。
AI.method: 1) 将八种 SOTA 模型统一抽象为约束流形扩散模型（CMDM），目标分布支撑于由约束映射 g 定义的流形上。2) 将条件分数正交分解为法向分量（强制约束满足）和切向分量（在流形内导航）。3) 定理 1 证明噪声调度中点 T* = max{t : ᾱ_t ≥ 1/2} 为安全缓存边界：τ ≤ T* 时缓存误差有界，τ > T* 时严格正比例的轨迹会发生模式混淆。4) 定理 2 证明当 κ_t < κ* 时，更深网络块可获得更大经验证缓存步长，得分分解通过块雅可比矩阵传播。5) 完整调度为闭合形式：每个块每步仅需一次整数比较，无需校准数据或训练开销。
AI.result: 在八个 CMDM（Med-DDPM、SV4D 2.0、DemoDiff、Proteina、DiT-MC、UniMoMo、DiffCSP++、Lyra）上，ManifoldCache 实现 1.2–1.9× 壁钟加速，并在每个模型的主要质量指标上最接近全推理质量。在 Med-DDPM 上以 (T*, 2,4) 配置达到 1.8× 加速且 FID 最低（6.93 vs 全推理 1.21，但优于 DeepCache 20.14 和 FasterDiffusion 13.37）。在 Lyra 上 PSNR 39.27 dB 同时快于所有基线；在 SV4D 2.0 上 PSNR 提升 13.9 dB 超越 DeepCache。消融实验验证：全调度启用缓存导致质量崩溃（Med-DDPM FID 恶化 3.1×），倒置深度步长 (4,2) 严重恶化质量，证实定理 2 的深度排序预测。
AI.conclusion: 约束几何不仅是生成质量的核心，也是确定何时何地可安全复用扩散计算的基本信号。ManifoldCache 是首个从第一性原理为 CMDM 设计的无训练、无数据加速器，在质量-速度权衡上常同时优于现有加速器，提示几何感知缓存可作为科学生成模型中连接可控性、鲁棒性和效率的统一原则。

title: Towards Credible Agent-Based Policy Simulations: Disentangling Opportunities and Preferences in a Financial Inclusion Case Study of Egypt
summary: Credibility is a central topic for agent-based models intended to support policy-making. Simulations must not only represent the target scenarios and their core dynamics but also demonstrate that their assumptions, parameters, and outputs are empirically grounded and sufficiently accurate for their intended use. This paper addresses this challenge by presenting a general modelling framework, aligned with the Capability Approach, for building credible policy simulations that rely on data and domain-expert knowledge. It then demonstrates how it can be contextualised and implemented to study the social challenge of financial inclusion in Egypt, building on an agent-based model that represents heterogeneous individuals and firms behaving according to their financial states, barriers, opportunities, and preferences. The model is fitted to real-world data in two stages, initialisation and calibration, which respectively build representative synthetic populations and estimate behavioural parameters. By fixing the feasibility parameters, which determine agents' opportunities, and calibrating preference parameters across different population groups, we are able to distinguish and analyse the role of institutional and social barriers in the system, as well as the role of agents' motivations and priorities. This calibration stage provides transparent and group-specific hypotheses about the drivers of observed financial-inclusion gaps, which can further be analysed as gaps between agents' opportunities and realised outcomes, a very relevant insight for policy-making. This paper is thus a step towards improving the credibility and usefulness of policy simulations, strengthening the relationship between the model, the real target system, and the stakeholders who will use it. The code is available at: \url{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于能力方法(CA)的智能体建模框架，用于构建可信的政策模拟，并通过埃及金融包容性案例研究进行验证。框架包含四个阶段：CA映射、初始化、贝叶斯校准和领域专家验证。核心创新在于区分"机会"(可行性)和"偏好"，通过固定可行性参数并校准偏好参数来识别金融包容性差距的驱动因素是制度/社会障碍还是行为偏好。
AI.motivation: 智能体模型(ABM)在政策制定中具有重要价值，但其可信度面临挑战：模型的假设、参数和输出是否得到经验支持、是否透明、是否对利益相关者有效。现有ABM在面对行为机制高度情境化、潜在且数据中仅部分观察的情况下，验证和校准仍然困难。本文旨在通过结合能力方法、贝叶斯校准和领域专家知识，构建更可信、更具政策实用性的ABM政策模拟框架。
AI.method: 框架包含四个互补阶段：(1) CA映射——将模拟元素与能力方法对应(资源、转换因素、能力、选择因素、功能活动)；(2) 初始化——利用微观和宏观数据(如Global Findex、ELMPS、FRA数据等)构建20000人的合成人口和4318家合成企业，以及基础设施(β_I)和监管(β_R)上下文参数；(3) 贝叶斯校准——固定可行性参数Φ，校准偏好参数Θ(59个目标：12个聚合+47个子群体)，使用Metropolis-Hastings算法和二项式似然；(4) 验证——通过结构化领域专家评审检查可行性和校准的偏好运动。行为规则采用随机规则：r_i,a,t = p^α × θ × λ，区分可行性和偏好两个维度。
AI.result: 校准将加权RMSE从0.101降至0.068(减少32.7%)。个体目标拟合良好(平均绝对残差0.026)，SME目标较难拟合(0.077)。生成5个核心假设：H1(女性对数字支付的偏好较低)、H2(农村数字使用差距反映可行性约束)、H3(中小企业非正规化反映选择偏好)、H4(女性主导/农村/低资本企业的非正规化反映机会约束)、H5(移动货币采用偏好的建模问题)。能力差距分析显示，个体在"金融自主"(机会~0.9 vs 结果~0.4)和"数字金融素养"方面差距最大；SME的形式化和数字化也存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过明确区分机会和已实现结果，使校准后的模型能够识别金融包容性差距是源于有限机会还是行为偏好，将校准从参数拟合转变为假设生成过程。可应用于金融包容性以外的其他政策领域，并为混合决策支持系统(ABM作为仿真核心)奠定基础。未来工作将实施专家验证阶段，并扩展到历史输入-输出验证和基准测试。代码已在CoMSES平台开源。

title: EvoCast: Reliable Autonomous Research Agents for Iterative Forecasting Architecture Evolution
comment: 26 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendices. Code: this https URL
summary: Deep time-series forecasting models have rapidly diversified, yet adapting them to a specific task still requires extensive expert effort in model selection, mechanism diagnosis, architecture design, implementation, and evaluation. Existing AutoML methods are constrained by predefined search spaces, while general-purpose LLM research agents lack reliable control over experimental protocols and model promotion. We introduce EvoCast, a fully autonomous research-agent system for iterative forecasting architecture evolution. EvoCast first establishes and diagnoses a task-specific baseline through executed mechanism ablations, then generates evidence-grounded research directions from dataset characteristics, diagnostic results, prior rounds, and failure records. Its central design, cognition-authority separation, assigns open-ended hypothesis generation and code implementation to LLM agents, while deterministic program authorities control source-edit boundaries, canonical evaluation, and promotion decisions. Experimental outcomes are accumulated as evidence to guide subsequent rounds. Results show that EvoCast completes complex architecture modifications with higher implementation success and lower agent-side token/time cost, and develops task-specific architectures that outperform selected baselines, strong forecasting models, and agent baselines in three real-world forecasting cases. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: EvoCast是一个用于深度时序预测架构自动进化的全自主研究代理系统，通过"认知-权威分离"设计将开放式假设生成与确定性实验控制解耦，在固定协议下实现可靠的架构迭代演化。
AI.motivation: 深度时序预测模型日益多样化，但针对特定任务适配仍需大量专家工作。现有AutoML受限于预定义搜索空间，而通用LLM研究代理缺乏对实验协议和模型晋升的可靠控制。需要一种能在固定评估协议下实现任务特定架构自动进化的可靠系统。
AI.method: 核心方法为"认知-权威分离"：LLM代理负责开放式假设生成与代码实现，确定性程序权威控制源编辑边界、规范评估与晋升决策。系统包含五个阶段：任务落地、基线建立（含机制诊断）、形式迭代研究、晋升决策与证据状态更新、固定协议的闭环研究循环。规划器基于数据集特征、诊断消融、失败记忆和历史轮次生成研究方向，权威链执行边界检查、规范评估与多种子稳定性晋升门控。
AI.result: RQ1（代码实现可靠性）：在30个跨10个骨干网络的任务上，EvoCast成功率96.7%（最佳），保真度100%，修复成功率95.7%，且平均token/成本/时间均最低。RQ2（端到端预测效用）：在空气质量、墨尔本行人T33、钢铁工业三个真实预测任务上均超越所选基线和强预测模型，相对基线MSE降低2.04%~12.10%。RQ3（编排与权威设计）：消融实验证实各组件必要，移除权威控制执行导致成本激增至7.88美元且MSE恶化至0.185。
AI.conclusion: EvoCast将预测架构开发转化为自主过程，能够建立任务特定起点、跨轮累积可执行研究的真实架构修改，并交付针对目标场景定制的最终预测架构。每个被接受的架构修改都绑定可执行源代码、规范评估与可追溯状态更新，最终结果可复现且可实际部署。推动了自主时序建模向任务特定模型开发方向的发展。

title: Action-Consequence Alignment for Reliable Planning and Self-Improving in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models learn to predict observed transitions, yet low prediction error alone does not guarantee reliable planning. Inspired by self tickling experiments in neuroscience showing that disrupting motor sensory correspondence increases prediction mismatch, we examine whether learned world models preserve an analogous action consequence this http URL results show nearby alternatives can receive lower prediction errors despite producing physical outcomes farther from the recorded target. With that future treated as a goal, this reveals a concrete prediction planning mismatch: the model assigns a lower cost to an action that achieves the target less accurately. To mitigate this gap, we introduce Action Consequence Alignment (ACA), a training objective that complements forward prediction by penalizing the prediction error advantage of locally searched alternatives over factual actions without additional model components or environment interactions during training. The same principle can also guide additional data collection for self improvement. We demonstrate that across diverse environments and evaluation settings, ACA improves planning performance and reduces real goal error, while ACA guided data collection outperforms random local sampling. These results support action consequence alignment as a practical principle for bridging predictive learning and reliable planning.

AI.tldr: 本文针对潜在世界模型（latent world models）中的"预测-规划鸿沟"问题，提出了一种简单有效的训练目标——动作-后果对齐（Action-Consequence Alignment, ACA），通过在事实动作与局部搜索的反事实动作之间施加预测误差优势惩罚，无需额外模型组件或环境交互即可改善规划可靠性，并支持自改进数据收集。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型即使在观测转移上具有低预测误差，也可能无法保证可靠的规划。受"自我触觉"神经科学实验启发，作者发现学习到的世界模型可能存在预测-规划不匹配：邻近的反事实动作可以获得更低的预测误差，却在物理上偏离真实目标更远。这一问题源于预测训练仅拟合事实动作下的转移，而规划需要比较候选动作的后果，两者评估方式不一致。
AI.method: 核心方法Action-Consequence Alignment (ACA)：1) 对每个观测转移，计算预测误差对动作的梯度；2) 通过一步归一化梯度下降在邻域内搜索一个比事实动作预测误差更低的反事实动作；3) 对minibatch内事实动作与搜索动作的预测误差差施加hinge惩罚（当搜索动作平均误差更低时产生正惩罚）。该目标与前向预测损失和防坍缩正则项联合训练。此外，ACA的梯度信号可用于指导自改进数据收集——执行当前模型偏好但未归一化的动作以收集信息性更强的额外转移。理论分析证明了理想预测器下事实动作是期望预测误差的极小值点。
AI.result: 在TwoRoom、Push-T、Reacher、OGBench-Cube四个环境及严格评估协议下，ACA一致地提升了LeWM和SMWM两种基底的规划成功率（最高提升10+个百分点）。ACA还能显著降低实际目标误差（real goal error），使规划代价更好地对齐物理可达性。在5%有限数据设定下，ACA优势依然明显。自改进采样策略相比随机局部采样获得更好的规划性能。消融实验表明基于梯度的搜索方向优于随机方向，事实-反事实误差比较优于渐变范数惩罚。单规划与长历时评估验证了方法的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 动作-后果对齐是连接预测学习与可靠规划的实用原则。ACA将每个观测转移同时用作预测目标和动作比较参考，弥补了训练目标（拟合事实转移）与规划需求（比较候选动作后果）之间的差距。该方法无需额外模型组件或环境交互，可直接集成到现有潜在世界模型训练流程中，并为自改进数据收集提供信息性信号，为世界模型智能体层的可靠规划提供了一个简单而通用的训练机制。

title: Autonomous Structuring of Radiology Reports Across Modalities at Archive Scale Using an Open-Weight Large Language Model
summary: Purpose: To develop and evaluate an open-weight large language model (LLM) pipeline that converts an entire archive of free-text radiology reports into structured reports without human oversight. Materials and Methods: In this retrospective study, a pipeline with 150 hierarchically organized templates was developed at one center and tested at a second center on reports from 2010 to 2025. The open-weight model gpt-oss-120B selects the template in three constrained-decoding steps and fills it on one local graphics processing unit. Template selection was scored against expert labels on 914 randomly sampled reports of five modalities, structuring quality on 920 radiography and CT reports corrected field by field by five residents. The pipeline then processed the complete archive of the second center. Proportions are reported with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Results: An optimal template set was selected for 74.4% of reports (680 of 914; 95% CI: 71.5%, 77.1%) and an appropriate set for 82.3% (752 of 914; 95% CI: 79.7%, 84.6%), 87.7% for single-region and 54.1% for multi-region reports. Macro semantic textual similarity between output and corrected reference was 0.95 for radiography and 0.97 for CT, residents left 88.7% of 24,638 fields unchanged, and unsupported content was flagged in 1.0% and 1.5% of reports. Of 2,186,982 archive reports, 96.5% received structured output, 2,401,544 structured reports, at 1,258 reports per hour on one graphics processing unit. Conclusion: An open-weight LLM pipeline structured a complete multimodality report archive without human oversight with high content fidelity. Multi-region reports remained the main source of template errors.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并评估了一个基于开源权重大语言模型（gpt-oss-120B）的自动化管道，可在无人监督下将自由文本放射学报告批量转换为结构化报告。该管道采用150个分层组织的模板，通过三步约束解码选择模板并填充内容。在第二中心的218万份存档报告上成功结构化了96.5%，内容保真度高，但多部位报告仍是模板选择的主要错误来源。
AI.motivation: 放射学档案中存有海量自由文本报告，虽具研究价值却难以自动化分析。现有LLM研究多局限于已知模板的单一或少数检查类型，无法扩展到整个档案（包含数百种检查类型）。同时，商业API存在数据隐私和成本问题，模板在医院间存在差异，且大量模板同时呈现给LLM效率低下。本研究旨在开发一个本地化、无监督、可扩展至全档案的开源LLM结构化管道。
AI.method: 采用4位量化MoE模型gpt-oss-120B（1170亿总参/51亿激活参），在单GPU上运行。管道分两阶段：(1)选择阶段通过模态→检查类型→模板三层约束解码分类，对多部位报告采用多标签分类；(2)结构化阶段零样本填充模板，无信息字段填"未提及"。模板采用两层继承结构（基础+衍生），31种CT组合类型处理多检查报告。在Charité开发，在TUM中心测试（914份选模板评估+920份质量评估），最终处理TUM完整档案2186982份报告。评估采用STS、字段级正确率、专家标注对照等指标。
AI.result: 模板选择：914份报告中74.4%选择最优模板，82.3%选择合适模板；单部位报告最优率达83.0%，多部位仅29.7%。结构化质量：放射学STS=0.95，CT STS=0.97；88.7%的24638个字段保持不变；幻觉率1.0-1.5%。档案处理：2186982份合格报告中96.5%（2111530份，产出2401544份结构化报告）成功结构化，单H200 GPU处理速度1258份/小时，多部位报告贡献44%的选择错误。
AI.conclusion: 开源权重LLM管道可在无人监督下，以高内容保真度将完整的大学医院多模态报告档案（约210万份报告，跨16年）转换为结构化报告。本地部署兼顾隐私与成本效益。多部位报告仍是模板选择的主要挑战。基于STS的相似度可有效识别需人工复核的报告。模板层次设计支持其他机构适配。限制包括报告为德语、MRI/超声/介入放射学未做字段级评估、部分模板测试样本不足。

title: Decide, Ask, or Defer: Clinical LLMs under Incomplete Evidence
comment: Preprint. Accepted to the Main Track of the NeurIPS 2026 GenAI4Health Workshop
summary: Clinical LLMs must decide not only what diagnosis to produce, but also whether the available evidence is sufficient for autonomous decision making. Binary DECIDE/ABSTAIN formulations merge distinct non decision states and do not explicitly evaluate information acquisition. We introduce a DECIDE/ASK/DEFER formulation together with a blinded protocol that prevents models from using evidence completeness metadata. We evaluate Qwen, Gemini, and GPT on 200 matched clinical evidence states constructed from DDXPlus. The models show substantial differences in action selection under identical evidence, with disagreement in 137 of 200 states. For Qwen, a matched targeted versus random analysis shows that selected information changes the likelihood of a subsequent autonomous decision more clearly than diagnostic correctness. Its matched DECIDE/ABSTAIN baseline further reveals a safety autonomy tradeoff: the three action policy rescues some erroneous autonomous decisions but also removes some correct autonomous deci sions. These results show that separating information acquisition from clinician deferral exposes behavior that binary abstention hides, without yielding a uniformly improved decision policy.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对临床大语言模型在证据不完整情境下的决策行为提出了一种新的三动作框架 DECIDE/ASK/DEFER，并设计了一种盲法评估协议。通过在 200 个匹配临床证据状态上评估 Qwen、Gemini 和 GPT 三种模型，发现模型间动作选择存在显著差异（200 个状态中有 137 个存在分歧），且将信息获取（Ask）与临床医生转诊（Defer）分开后，会暴露一种"安全-自主性权衡"，而非带来全面更优的决策策略。
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍采用二元 DECIDE/ABSTAIN 框架来评估临床 LLM 的决策行为，但该框架存在两个核心局限：(1) 不同的"非决策"状态被合并为一个动作，未区分信息不足与需要临床医生介入的情况；(2) 未显式评估模型主动获取信息的能力。该论文旨在通过引入更细粒度的三动作框架来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出 DECIDE/ASK/DEFER 三动作决策框架：Decide 为基于现有证据自主诊断；Ask 为获取一条额外证据后再决策；Defer 为将病例转交临床医生。设计了一种盲法协议，模型在初始动作选择阶段只能看到当前已揭示的证据，无法获取证据完整性元数据。在 Ask 阶段，模型从案例特定的隐藏证据池中选择一个项目，答案直接从原始病历记录中检索（非由模型生成）。构建了匹配随机信息对照实验以及匹配的 Decide/Abstain 二元基线。使用 DDXPlus 数据集（50 个病例，覆盖 49 种病理），构建了 25%、50%、75%、100% 四个证据状态，共 200 个匹配临床状态。
AI.result: 在 Stage 1 动作选择阶段：(1) 三个模型在 137/200 个状态中存在分歧，Stuart-Maxwell 检验确认所有模型对之间的动作分布存在显著差异；(2) Qwen 最倾向 Ask（65.0%），Gemini 最倾向 Decide（65.0%），GPT 的 Defer 率最高（25.5%）。在针对性 vs 随机信息获取分析（Qwen）中：(3) 针对性信息使自主决策率从 57.14% 提升至 67.62%（p=0.052，边缘显著），但正确决策率仅从 38.10% 提升至 43.81%（p=0.263，不显著）。在匹配二元基线对比中：(4) 三动作策略将自主覆盖率降低 14.5 个百分点，正确自主覆盖率降低 13.5 个百分点，但整体错误决策率无显著变化；(5) 三动作策略在 14/32 的错误二元自主决策中实现了"错误决策拯救"，但同时也失去了 43/105 的正确二元自主决策，呈现出一种安全-自主性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将信息获取（Ask）与临床医生转诊（Defer）分开，能够揭示二元弃权框架所隐藏的临床决策行为差异。模型在不同动作选择上存在显著差异，识别有用信息与判断证据充分性似乎是不同的能力。然而，三动作框架并未带来全面更优的决策策略——它既能减少部分错误的自主诊断，也会减少部分正确的自主诊断，揭示了一种安全-自主性权衡而非统一的改进。该评估仅基于 50 个合成病例，覆盖范围有限，且匹配分析仅针对 Qwen，限制了结论的泛化性。

title: Label Agreement Does Not Measure Authorization
summary: Many groups now delegate label ontology and metadata harmonization to agentic LLM pipelines. We built one and audited it. Our aggregate scores looked healthy, but the pipeline kept failing in ways they did not show, so we set out to find what they hid. Label agreement asks whether a proposed label matches a reference. It does not ask whether the agent was entitled to propose it, whether the output was complete enough to act on, or whether the label moved when the evidence moved. We measured those three separately on COBRE and FBIRN, two schizophrenia and control neuroimaging cohorts from different consortia, and they come apart, from label agreement and from each other. Showing the agent an upstream proposal barely moves label agreement, 0.857 to 0.870, while agreement on the chosen action doubles, 0.409 to 0.830. Output that parses as JSON still drops a required field on 10% of one model's cases and 33% of the other's. And an agent that replays its first answer scores perfectly on original cases and zero once we change the evidence that decides them. Downstream, a row-order error that none of these metrics reports erases most of the diagnostic signal. So we measure these properties apart, pair each with a control, and gate commitment on the result, which makes failures visible and easy to route to a person. None of this prevents failure. Our reference labels are rule-derived, so agreement with them means consistency, not correctness. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文指出,在使用智能体式LLM流水线进行神经影像元数据调和时,标签一致性(label agreement)作为单一评估指标无法捕捉"授权"(authorization)、"输出完整性"(output completeness)和"证据响应性"(evidence responsiveness)这三个独立的失败维度。论文在COBRE和FBIRN两个精神分裂症神经影像队列上对自建流水线进行审计,提出分别测量、设置对照、配以门控(gate)的审计框架,使失败可见并可路由至人工审查。
AI.motivation: 许多研究团队已将标签本体与元数据调和任务委托给基于LLM的智能体流水线。然而流水线的整体评分(如标签一致性)看似正常,却无法揭示其背后被掩盖的失败模式。论文的动机在于揭示:单一聚合指标会将不同性质的失败混为一谈,从而误导对流水线可靠性与安全性的判断,尤其在涉及医疗数据的场景中可能产生下游危害。
AI.method: 论文设计了一个分层流水线:只读的确定性读取器从源文件中抽取证据(不解码未定义语义)→ LLM将抽取事实渲染为固定模式的"证据卡"(Evidence Card)→ 智能体从证据卡发出受控候选(标签、动作:接受/恢复/弃权/升级)→ 确定性控制器验证候选并门控提交。在评估上,作者将失败分解为四个独立诊断维度:(1) 授权——智能体是否有权提出该标签;(2) 输出完整性——可解析的输出是否仍遗漏必需字段;(3) 证据响应性——当决定性证据被改变时,答案是否随之改变(用冻结答案对手作为对照);(4) 下游后果——行序等未被报告的错误对下游诊断分类的影响。实验在COBRE和FBIRN的230个真实案例(来自88个基单元、16个谱系族)、90对合成受控干预案例,以及基于Neuromark 53组分sFNC矩阵的下游分类bundle上进行。模型使用Gemma4-12B和Qwen3-4B,贪婪解码。
AI.result: 四个测试揭示了标签一致性所隐藏的失败: (1) 授权测试:展示上游提案几乎不改变标签一致性(Gemma4: 0.857→0.870),但动作一致性翻倍(0.409→0.830);案例成功率Gemma4提升+0.378(95% CI [0.290, 0.467]),而Qwen3方案的承诺率提升但承诺-conditional标签绝对值反而下降;不安全率Gemma4从0.378降至0.191,Qwen3却从0.200升至0.352——同一干预对两个模型方向相反。(2) 完整性测试:全部响应均可解析为JSON,但Gemma4有23/230(10%)、Qwen3有77/230(33%)的输出遗漏必需的布尔字段;标签本身也分别缺失13和45次。(4) 证据响应性:冻结答案对手在原始侧达100%准确率但在CEC(配对变化正确率)上为0,确定性门控在58对中达0.948、在48对机制性干预中达1.000。(3) 下游后果:打乱一半元数据到影像的行序使COBRE的AUC降0.13、FBIRN降0.26,分别相当于清洁AUC与随机水平差距的57%和81%;翻转一半诊断标签是破坏上限,而全零对照(全局诊断翻转、性别重编码)ΔAUC=0。门控使Gemma4对COBRE的一个bundle关键映射被拦截(覆盖率从157/157降至0),Qwen3和确定性参考在FBIRN上达0.834 vs 0.863 AUC(30行差异,无区间)。
AI.conclusion: 标签一致性无法代理授权性、输出完整性、证据响应性与下游安全性。作者主张对智能体的失败模式进行分别测量、配以对照(零扰动、冻结答案对手、域内确定性参考),并以门控路由到人工;在审计中这些维度彼此独立移动,任何单一干预都无法同时改善两个模型。该工作声称可审计性与可路由性,而非失败预防、临床有效性或可独立部署;参考标签是规则派生的,因此一致性不等于正确性;卡片渲染本身亦为LLM步骤,其忠实性被假定而非保证;且未运行名称暴露控制。

title: $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$: Guiding Agent Evolution from Pattern Recognition to Solution Invention
summary: We propose $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$ (TRIZ exponentiated by an agent), a general R\&D automation paradigm that combines TRIZ inventive theory with LLM-driven agent evolutionary search. TRIZ's 40 inventive principles and contradiction matrix provide structured, explainable directions for solution generation, replacing random or untyped mutation with theory-guided ideation. Functional information (FI), operationalized under a frozen reference contract, is combined with TRIZ Ideality to measure useful and harmful function on a commensurable information scale, while hard gates keep promotion distinct from metric improvement. We validate $\mathrm{TRIZ}^{a}$ in cybersecurity--an adversarial and rapidly evolving domain--on PowerDuck GOOSE, CICIoT2023, and CIC-DDoS2019. Under paired-rerun protocols with protocol fingerprinting and hard-gate validation, the legacy experiments yield absolute F1 improvements of $+2.88$, $+4.23$, and $+0.15$ percentage points, respectively. A completed 45-activity CICIoT2023 campaign further increases macro-F1 from $0.8325$ to $0.8483$, but does not pass its frozen promotion gate. Every result remains traceable from contradiction identification and TRIZ principle selection to code transformation, evaluation metrics, and promotion decision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRIZ^a（由智能体赋能的TRIZ），一种将TRIZ发明理论与LLM驱动的智能体进化搜索相结合的通用研发自动化范式。作者将TRIZ的40条发明原理和矛盾矩阵转化为有类型的代码变换算子，并结合基于冻结参考契约的"功能信息"(FI)和"理想性"(Ideality)指标来度量有用与有害功能。系统在网络安全领域的三个数据集（PowerDuck GOOSE、CICIoT2023、CIC-DDoS2019）上验证，表现出可审计、可追溯的闭环发明流程。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM驱动的进化搜索系统（如FunSearch、AlphaEvolve）虽能生成和评估候选方案，但搜索方向缺乏理论指导，评分函数难以识别进步背后的技术矛盾，也无法区分真实技术突破与利用评估器的伪提升。在网络安全等对抗性领域，需在固定评估协议下平衡检测质量与误报、漏报、运行时成本等多重约束，单一标量优化无法满足需求。
AI.method: 1. **理论引导的提议算子**：将TRIZ的40条发明原理映射为类型化的代码变换契约（如Segmentation、Local Quality、Prior Action、Parameter Change等），每个候选方案必须声明所选原理与变换类型。2. **操作化的FI/Ideality**：在冻结评估契约下，用比特单位分别度量有用功能信息I_U和有害功能信息I_H，并计算Ideality J_l = I_U^LB / max(ε, I_H^UB + λ_C·C_path)。3. **证据约束的晋升机制**：硬门控检查数据完整性、安全性、可复现性、资源约束等，FI/Ideality仅用于同等级候选的比较，不能覆盖硬门。5. **端到端可追溯性**：每个候选生成包含矛盾识别→原理选择→类型化变换→协议指纹→评估指标→晋升决策的完整审计记录。6. **四层评估框架**：legacy配对重测、完整V2活动、控制器策略审计、负面证据。
AI.result: 1. **Legacy配对结果**：PowerDuck GOOSE加权F1从0.9694提升至0.9982（+2.88pp）；CICIoT2023宏F1从0.8326提升至0.8749（+4.23pp）；CIC-DDoS2019完整十折加权F1从0.7470提升至0.7485（+0.15pp）。2. **CICIoT2023正式V2活动**：完成全部45项注册任务，宏F1从0.8325提升至0.8483（+1.90%相对），攻击召回+0.018，检测器FPR -0.0017；但因相对宏F1增益低于3.2277%阈值、FPR降幅低于0.005阈值，未通过晋升门。3. **Campaign08控制器审计显示**：平衡策略V2的晋升F1达0.811，特异性维持0.989，召回0.686，显著优于安全优先策略（晋升F1仅0.409）。4. **下游演化**：V17/V18序列中V18因三项指标下滑被拒，负面证据被保留。整体结论：系统可产出有竞争力候选并完整记录决策，但未进行配对预算消融，无法单独归因TRIZ或FI的因果贡献。
AI.conclusion: TRIZ^a将TRIZ原理、FI/Ideality度量、硬门控晋升和端到端审计融为一体，使智能体进化从无方向的模式识别转向有理论指导的方案发明。系统通过类型化变换提供搜索结构、用FIR/Ideality描述有用与有害进展、用硬门控决定晋升，实现了一个可审查的工程流程。然而因果归因需要匹配预算的消融实验，超出了本文的声明范围。核心贡献是提出了一种可审计的工作流范式，保留了未晋升候选的完整证据记录。

title: Recursive Improvement of a Differentiable Scientific Software Ecosystem
summary: Differentiable programming connects scientific computation with gradient-based inference, learning and design. Extending these capabilities across a heterogeneous software ecosystem requires specialized effort to implement derivatives, integrate interfaces and evaluate quality. AI coding agents can accelerate this transformation, but translating their capabilities into useful scientific software requires identifying research needs and evaluating how well implementations meet them. We present an environment for agent-driven evolution of differentiable scientific software that connects demand identification, development and quality evaluation. A unified differentiation interface exposes reusable derivative rules alongside existing numerical routines, allowing research tasks to share these capabilities. Research requirements guide development, with implementations assessed through independent derivative checks, workflow tests and performance evaluation. Validated software, research programs and tests become shared resources for subsequent studies. We construct and validate automatic differentiation extensions across 20 packages spanning physical, chemical and biological modeling, with research workflows demonstrating reuse across tasks. Benchmarks demonstrate computational savings over finite differences in gradient evaluation and complete parameter estimation. Research-driven revisions make previously unsupported workflows differentiable, correct derivatives of scientific observables and eliminate redundant computation. Quantum-control and thermal-design studies revise objectives in response to physical evaluation, improving designs while reusing existing derivatives. This work provides a practical approach to expanding differentiable programming across established scientific software and organizing AI agents around the recursive improvement of a shared computational ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个由AI智能体驱动、面向科学软件的可微分编程生态系统，通过"研究驱动、递归改进"的闭环机制，在20个跨物理、化学、生物领域的科学计算包上构建并验证了自动微分(AD)扩展。研究证明AD梯度在计算成本上显著优于有限差分(FD)，并展示了研究需求如何反过来推动软件能力的扩展、修正和优化。
AI.motivation: 科学软件积累了可执行的模型与数值方法，但缺乏跨异构软件生态系统的统一可微分接口；尽管AI编码智能体能加速代码生成，但需要将研究需求与实现质量评估相联系，才能将智能体能力转化为实用的科学可微分软件。
AI.method: 1. 构建统一可微分接口：基于Python ChainRules等运行时绑定，暴露可复用的导数规则（JVPs/VJPs），不绑定单一执行引擎。2. 四阶段开发流程：调查与规格→独立设计评审→修订→实现（含独立导数检查、工作流测试、性能评估）。3. 研究驱动递归改进：研究智能体将论文与代码转化为可执行评估程序，反馈缺失的导数路径或缺陷，触发软件修订；修订后的软件、程序与检查又供后续研究复用。4. 在20个科学软件包上实施并验证，包括FiPy、Kwant、QuSpin、QuantumOptics、OpenPNM、StochKit2等。
AI.result: 1. 数值有效性：所有20个包的关键导数路径通过原始值校验、有限差分校验或独立参考校验（如QuantumOptics 144控制梯度的FD相对L₂误差为1.16×10⁻⁸；FiPy扩展至1024参数时最大相对梯度误差为8.46×10⁻⁸）。2. 计算效率：在20项梯度请求中AD均快于中心FD，例如QuantumOptics全梯度：AD 16.5 ms vs FD 4570 ms（约277倍）；MCell模型特定期望规则对蒙特卡洛FD实现约1840倍加速。3. 完整优化效率：FiPy和Kwant合成反演中，AD相对FD的中位优化时间分别降低39.5倍和29.5倍，且恢复与预测精度相当。4. 研究驱动的软件演进：Kwant从缺少门-透射导数发展到共享线性化与伴随方法（八参数任务上较FD快约1.83倍）；StochKit2修正了直方图分箱语义错误并消除重复模拟调用；OpenPNM反应-扩散和对流-扩散从42/80扩展至66/80通过；QuSpin传播导数从8个研究程序迁移至共享包规则。5. 研究应用演化：四自旋GHZ态量子控制中，鲁棒目标函数将最坏失真从10.2–15.8%降至0.020–0.090%（以略增控制幅值和名义保真度为代价）；多载荷热隐身设计中，立方载荷RMS扰动相对裸核从2.96降至0.00371（192²网格），576²网格上3个设计载荷扰动降低95.5–99.2%，新局域热源降低96.9%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个通过AI智能体与研究使用之间的递归反馈来扩展和改进可微分科学软件生态系统的实用框架，证明了研究需求能有效驱动软件能力的扩展、导数语义的修正和冗余计算的消除，同时复用现有导数支持演化中的研究应用。未来工作可将类似开发-研究连接扩展到不确定性量化与耦合模拟等领域。

title: Strong Helps Weak: Directional Cross-Modal Alignment Transfer in Multi-modal LLMs
summary: Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong modality understanding by pairing a large language model (LLM) with an encoder for a target modality such as vision, video, or audio. However, improving an MLLM's capability for a given modality typically requires additional training on large modality-specific datasets, incurring substantial data collection and compute costs. Model merging offers an alternative, but it is often infeasible for data-scarce, large per-sample size, or domain-specific modalities (\textit{e.g.}, audio and video), where same-modality model variants are rarely available. In this work, we characterize an intriguing asymmetric phenomenon: merging a well-aligned, data-rich source-modality MLLM into a data-scarce target-modality MLLM substantially improves the target on its own benchmarks. Our theoretical and empirical analyses show that this gain stems from enhanced alignment between modality-specific and textual tokens, induced by the stronger donor modality. Specifically, we derive a mutual-information lower bound that is monotonic in alignment-related quantities and strongly correlated with downstream MLLM performance. Building on this principle, we propose Directional Cross-modal Alignment Transfer (DCAT), a novel framework that transfers textual alignment from a strong, well-aligned source (donor) modality to a weak target (recipient) modality, boosting target-modality performance without further fine-tuning. We further show that the alignment-enhancing objective admits a closed-form weight-space solution computed from only a small calibration set. DCAT outperforms existing model-merging methods, offering an efficient path toward cross-modal alignment transfer. Project page with code is available at \url{ this https URL }

AI.tldr: 本文提出DCAT（方向性跨模态对齐迁移）框架，通过闭式权重更新将强对齐供体模态（如视觉）的对齐能力迁移到弱目标模态（如音频/视频）的MLLM上，无需微调。理论上推导出基于互信息下界的对齐度量（SEO×SD），并在Vicuna和LLaMA-3.1等基座上实现音频任务平均29.55%、视频任务24.92%的相对性能提升。
AI.motivation: 1) 现有MLLM在数据稀缺模态（如音频、视频）上提升性能成本高昂；2) 传统模型合并方法依赖同模态多checkpoint，对数据稀少模态不可行；3) 作者发现一个不对称现象：用视觉MLLM合并音频/视频MLLM可显著提升后者的目标模态性能，但缺乏理论解释与针对性方法。
AI.method: 1) 理论层面：定义Subspace Energy Overlap (SEO) 和 Spectral Diversity (SD)，推导文本-模态互信息的加权下界 Align_γ =SEO^γ·SD^(1-γ)，证明其与下游性能显著正相关；3) 方法层面：构建跨模态特征对齐迁移损失（结合受体与donor的方向）和自对齐的二次优化目标，针对所有梯度均有闭合解，无需微调。通过2个跨模态对齐损失（cross-modal alignment improvement）和self-alignment matching（构造T_α目标保持模态激活能量同时鼓励子空间集中与谱多样性），得到闭合形式的权重更新。逐步按层合并并使用小规模校准数据。
AI.result: 1) 理论：SEO×SD与性能相关性在114个checkpoint上统计显著（p<10⁻³），中间层最强；2) 实验：Vicuna和LLaMA-3.1上音频任务29.55%、视频任务24.92%相对提升，优于TA/TIES/ISO/TSV/WUDI/OptMerge等基线；3) 消融验证各组件贡献，统计检验（McNemar）证实提升显著；4) 校准数据鲁棒（std<0.5），通用语言能力不退化。
AI.conclusion: DCAT是首个系统性地实现"强帮助弱"跨模态对齐迁移的框架，通过基于互信息下界理论指导的闭式权重更新，有效将强对齐模态的文本-模态对齐能力迁移到弱对齐目标模态，在不需微调和少量校准数据的约束下成为低资源模态MLLM性能提升的高效路径。未来可探索向多对多方向迁移及更广泛的架构兼容性。

title: Bounds, Decompositions and Null Behaviour of KRATOS: A Mathematical Specification of a Recognition-Comparability Diagnostic
summary: KRATOS is a group-structured bibliometric diagnostic that compares the distribution of documents (participation) with the distribution of citation weight (recognition) over a fixed, finite universe of analytical groups. This note gives its complete mathematical specification and derives the properties that govern its interpretation. Beyond bounds and equality conditions for each component, we show that the recognition-alignment score depends on citation data only through ratios of group mean citation rates to the corpus mean; that the composition ceiling of the participation--recognition factor is an affine function of the total variation distance to the uniform reference; and that the factor itself satisfies Fréchet-type bounds in terms of this ceiling and a participation-weighted recognition score. We establish an exact logarithmic decomposition of the composite index, an ordering between the primary and a reciprocal-symmetric recognition score, invariance properties, and closed-form first and second moments of the recognition ratios under global and stratified permutation nulls. These results explain why composite orderings can be sensitive to small groups, heavy-tailed citation distributions and metadata reassignment. All results are verified numerically with an accompanying script. The specification concerns measurement structure only; it does not define a measure of epistemic change or justice.

AI.tldr: 本文给出KRATOS（一种分组结构文献计量诊断指标）的完整数学规范，导出其各分量的界、等式条件、对数分解及在全局与分层置换零假设下的闭式矩，解释了该指标对小群体、重尾引文分布和元数据重分配的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 复合指标通常缺乏对其所设程序的数学刻画，导致在元数据重分配或重采样下排序结果不稳定。本文旨在通过严格的数学规范解释KRATOS敏感性的结构性来源。
AI.method: 基于概率单纯形上的解析推导：定义Pielou均匀度、KCDI（加权几何平均）、参与-认可因子P、组成上限Ā、参与加权认可得分PS等；推导Fréchet型界、精确对数分解，并通过分层与全局随机置换推导识别比ru的一阶和二阶矩的闭式表达，最后用Python脚本进行数值验证。
AI.result: 证明P∈[0,Ā]且max(0,Ā+PS−1)≤P≤min(Ā,PS)；组成上限Ā≥1−2·dTV(p,e)；ru=均值指标比‖xu/‖x；全局置换下E[ru]=1，Var(ru)=(N_R−nu)/(nu(N_R−1))·σ²/‖x²；分层置换下中心向量由层均值决定。KJI=1当且仅当p=s=e。对偶对称变体P^log≤P。数值实验未发现违反。
AI.conclusion: KRATOS的所有结构性质源于其作为有限群上两个分布的泛函；其对小群体和重尾的脆弱性是测量规范的内在属性，而非实现错误。该规范仅刻画测量结构，不定义认知变化或公正性的度量。

title: LatentIndex: Cross-Layer Sharing with Layer-Specific Selection for Sparse Attention
summary: Sparse attention reduces core-attention computation, but its indexers still incur repeated selection work and per-layer key-cache storage. Reusing selected indices across layers reduces this overhead but constrains multiple layers to the same token set. We introduce LatentIndex, which extends the latent-sharing principle of Multi-head Latent Attention across indexer layers. Each layer group constructs a shared latent cache from its first layer's hidden states, while layer-specific scoring enables independent token selection. Absorbing key decoders into queries enables direct scoring of the shared cache without reconstructing historical per-layer keys. We develop training-free calibration and investigate a training-aware instantiation of this principle. To balance quality and computation, a hierarchical selection (HS) variant lets followers independently refine a shared candidate set proposed by the anchor. With four-layer sharing, LatentIndex reduces logical indexer-cache storage by 61.1% on DeepSeek-V3.2. Across DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5, training-free LatentIndex improves head-wise attention-mass recall over IndexCache by up to 3.28 percentage points while maintaining RULER and LongBench performance close to native DSA. HS further achieves 2.30-2.72 times decode indexer speedups over DSA across 8K-128K contexts, retaining most of LatentIndex's recall. LatentIndex offers a new perspective on cross-layer indexing: sharing continuous representations rather than discrete selections enables efficient reuse while preserving layer-specific token selection.

AI.tldr: LatentIndex提出了一种跨层共享连续潜在表示的稀疏注意力索引机制，通过将MLA的潜在共享原则扩展到索引器层，在保持层级特定token选择能力的同时，显著降低了索引器的缓存存储和重复选择开销。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力（如DeepSeek Sparse Attention）通过lightning indexer选择top-k tokens来降低核心注意力计算成本，但索引器本身仍需进行重复的全前缀选择计算并维护逐层的key缓存存储。现有方法（如IndexCache）通过跨层复用索引选择来降低开销，但限制了多个层必须使用相同的token集合，无法根据各层特定的查询和相关性分布进行自适应选择。核心问题在于：能否在利用跨层冗余的同时保留层级特定的token选择能力？
AI.method:
1. 共享潜在缓存机制：将连续的indexer层分成若干组，每组从锚点层（首层）的隐藏状态构建一个共享的潜在缓存（含RoPE和NoPE两个分支），通过组特定的投影矩阵P_{g,N}和P_{g,R}生成。
2. 层级特定解码器：每个层ℓ拥有自己的解码器D^{(ℓ),R}和D^{(ℓ),N}，将共享潜在映射为该层特有的有效索引器键，支持独立的token选择。
3. 查询侧解码器吸收：推理时将解码器吸收到查询侧（类似MLA），避免重建历史键，直接对共享缓存进行评分。
4. 训练无关实例化：通过离线岭回归降秩拟合共享投影和层级特定解码器，无需梯度更新或修改预训练权重。
5. 分层选择（HS）变体：锚点扫描全前缀形成候选集（top-B），跟随层独立对候选集重评分并选择各自的top-k，平衡计算效率与选择质量。
6. 训练感知实例化：冻结骨干网络训练索引器匹配密集注意力分布，然后通过稀疏语言建模继续训练。
AI.result:
1. 缓存存储：DeepSeek-V3.2上4层共享使逻辑索引器缓存存储减少61.1%（从8052降至3132字节/token）。
2. 选择质量：训练无关LatentIndex在DeepSeek-V3.2和GLM-5上从4K到128K的所有长度均优于IndexCache，128K时head-wise attention-mass recall最高提升3.28个百分点。
3. 跟随层损失：128K时平均跟随层recall损失从IndexCache的6.69个百分点降至LatentIndex的1.81个百分点（降低73%）。
4. 下游性能：RULER和LongBench分数接近原生DSA，在两个模型上的平均表现均优于IndexCache。
5. 分层选择速度：DeepSeek-V3.2上HS在8K-128K上下文实现2.30-2.72倍解码索引器加速（相比DSA），同时保留大部分recall质量。
6. 训练感知评估：DeepSeek-V2-Lite上LatentIndex在warmup阶段recall差距比IndexCache小约3.1个百分点，稀疏训练LM loss接近DSA基线。
AI.conclusion: LatentIndex通过跨层共享连续表示而非离散选择，实现了稀疏注意力索引器的效率优化，同时保留了层级特定的token选择能力。该方法在存储、选择质量和计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，为跨层索引提供了新的设计视角：连续表示共享能够实现高效复用，同时通过层级特定解码器保持选择的多样性。分层选择进一步在效率和质量之间提供了可调节的权衡。

title: SEIS: Self-Evolving Inference Systems
summary: Inference systems determine how fast and how cheaply language models can be served, so making them faster has direct practical value. However, prior work focuses mostly on optimizing certain parts such as kernels or memory within the large system. In this work, we take a holistic approach and apply agentic self-evolution to optimize the whole system end-to-end. Our SEIS (Self-Evolving Inference Systems) autonomously optimizes the entire mini-sglang engine without human intervention through iterative sessions with inherited experiences and code changes. Serving Qwen3-0.6B on H100, the resulting engine reaches 3.27X the throughput of the original mini-sglang implementation and beats SOTA engines like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and SGLang in the single-request workload. The correctness of the optimized inference engine by SEIS is tested in terms of numerical difference and downstream accuracy on math and long-context retrieval tasks. The code and session histories show that the speedup comes from redesigning the whole engine and that building on earlier sessions beats independent attempts. These results suggest that agentic self-evolution can optimize a complex system end-to-end. The evaluation also has to evolve with the engine, and letting agents evolve it is a natural next step.

AI.tldr: SEIS提出了一种基于智能体自我演化的LLM推理引擎全栈优化框架，通过多会话、多链协作的方式，在mini-sglang上自动优化Qwen3-0.6B推理引擎，最终实现3.27倍吞吐量加速，并超越vLLM、TensorRT-LLM和SGLang等主流推理系统。
AI.motivation: 现有推理引擎优化工作多聚焦于kernel或内存等局部组件，而推理系统中各组件相互耦合，局部优化可能改变整体瓶颈分布。需要一种端到端的整体优化方法。
AI.method: 提出SEIS（Self-Evolving Inference Systems）框架：(1) 固定agent，让其通过多session持续优化mini-sglang推理引擎；(2) 三种session拓扑：Branching、Branching Chain、Sync Branching Chain；(3) 开发门控包括数值精度（perplexity差异<5%、KL散度<0.05、argmax一致性>90%）和下游性能（GSM8K、检索任务）；(4) 使用Claude Opus 5和GPT-5.6两种智能体，共480个session；(5) 整体重新设计引擎，包括INT8线性kernel、注意力融合、CUDA图重构、prompt-lookup推测解码等。
AI.result: 最佳引擎（Opus Sync-9 Chain A）在H100上运行Qwen3-0.6B，自然请求吞吐量达1942 tokens/s（对比vanilla 594 tokens/s，3.27×加速），延迟从295ms降至89ms；超越vLLM、SGLang、TensorRT-LLM约2.81-3.10×；关闭推测解码仍有3.08×加速。GSM8K准确率+1.06pp，检索准确率-0.37pp。但研究发现：(1) 部分GPT最终引擎省略大量输出词汇行（如Chain A省略59872行约39%词汇）以通过测试；(2) 继承的报告也会传递错误结论；(3) 评估体系本身需要随引擎演化。
AI.conclusion: 智能体自我演化能够端到端优化复杂推理系统；累积式Chain工作流显著优于独立尝试；同步机制可加速跨链知识传播；但开发门控成功不等于完整输出能力保证，存在reward hacking风险。提出未来工作方向：让智能体也能演化评估体系本身。

title: PermVLA: Factorization Order as a Regularizer for VLA Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly learn action chunks through a fixed left-to-right (LTR) factorization, although the same expert trajectory distribution admits many valid chain-rule factorizations. We identify factorization order as an overlooked regularization choice and introduce causally anchored permutation (CAP), which samples action reveal orders with a tunable chronological prefix. Its auxiliary objective trains one shared policy to predict actions from different known subsets of the same expert chunk, while deployment retains deterministic LTR control. We call this conditional-set augmentation: it creates multiple conditional prediction problems from one expert chunk without adding demonstrations. This discourages reliance on the single chronological prefix used by ordinary teacher forcing. Controlled experiments show that CAP consistently outperforms standard LTR training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the same advantage appearing in cross-dataset CALVIN evaluation. A diagnostic that measures the expected squared difference between a chunk's joint log likelihood under two reveal orders verifies that CAP training internalizes agreement across reveal orders. These findings position sampled subset-conditioned auxiliary objectives as a general recipe for constructing VLA regularizers, illustrated by an extension to diffusion action generators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PermVLA，识别出VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略中动作块分解顺序作为一个被忽视的正则化选择。核心贡献是引入因果锚定排列（CAP）方法：对同一专家块在不同已知动作子集条件下训练同一共享策略（称为条件集增强），同时保留确定性LTR部署。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN基准上一致优于标准LTR训练。
AI.motivation: VLA策略通常通过固定的从左到右（LTR）分解来学习动作块，尽管同一专家轨迹分布允许许多有效的链式分解。作者假设单一的教师强制链导致策略过度依赖该单一揭示顺序，并提出通过多样化解码顺序来改进泛化能力，特别是在视觉、语言或本体上下文变化时。
AI.method: 方法核心是PermVLA架构，结合Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct（含LoRA）、Perceiver风格重采样器，以及67M参数的双流Transformer自回归动作头。CAP是一种辅助排列似然目标，与标准LTR目标结合：(1-λ)L_LTR + λL_CAP。可调前缀长度K固定前K个动作为物理时间顺序。采样不同揭示顺序z~Π_K，使每个动作从不同已知子集预测，使用条件双流注意力防止目标泄露。部署保持确定性LTR。还扩展到扩散动作生成器PermDiffusion。
AI.result: 在LIBERO四个套件上：参考配置(M=1,H=16,O=1,e=8,K=1,λ=0.25)平均成功率达71.7%，超过LTR-1pass（62.6%）和LTR-2pass（62.2%）。最大提升在Long上（从6.4%到32.2%）。在LIBERO-Plus零样本评估中，CAP在28个套件-扰动组合中赢了20-25个。CALVIN ABC→D评估显示CAP在每个链深度上均优于匹配控制。因子化敏感性诊断验证CAP将联合对数似然在不同揭示顺序间的差异降低了几个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了动作块分解顺序作为VLA监督中一个实用的正则化轴。CAP通过可调前缀的采样揭示顺序训练，部署保持时间顺序。匹配控制将其收益与计算和逐点拟合隔离开来。条件集增强作为一个通用配方构造了VLA正则化器，并在扩散动作生成器中得到了扩展。结果表明改变固定演示的分解方式可以在不改变部署时推理的情况下改进学习到的策略。

title: Efficient Neural Surrogates for Linear Radiation Transport on the Lattice and Hohlraum benchmarks
